notes.title: Join the Fan Art Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/e3b61825e27088dc70c90311409e8b716f8c240d.png[/img]
It's time for another epic fan art contest!

To participate, submit a new fan art of your own making to the 100% Orange Juice Steam community Artwork gallery with the hashtag [b]#contest2025[/b] and emailed to [url=support@fruitbatfactory.com]support@fruitbatfactory.com[/url] (see notes below) by August 31, 14:00 PDT!

Top 10 entries will win a prize!
[list][*][b]1st place[/b]: Plushie of your choice + in-game contest winner pin!
[*][b]2nd-3rd place[/b]: Fruitbat Factory game or DLC of choice (some restrictions apply) 
[*][b]4th-10th place[/b]: 100% orange Juice DLC of your choice, or a gift copy of 100% Orange Juice[/list]

Any art related to 100% Orange Juice is accepted. Let your imagination run wild!

We also have [b]3 bonus categories [/b]that will each get 3 winners! 

[list][*]Best Together
[*]Worst Together
[*]Representing the Underrepresented[/list]

Entries won't need to be submitted to these bonus categories. Judges will independently pick contestants for them out of the all the entries!

The winners in these extra categories will receive: 
[list][*][b]1st place[/b]: Plushie of your choice + in-game contest winner pin!
[*][b]2nd-3rd place[/b]: Fruitbat Factory game or DLC of choice (some restrictions apply)[/list]

Top 3 works in both the main and bonus categories will be featured in the in-game gallery and turned into player plate backgrounds!

Art can be submitted any number of times.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Submissions must both be posted in the Artwork section of the steam hub with the tag #contest2025, AND e-mailed to support@fruitbatfactory.com.

The email must include the following:
Subject: 100% Orange Juice Fan Art Contest
Link to Steam Artwork section entry.
Desired name to be credited in-game and on social media in case of a win.
Full quality art, plus 2 in-progress versions of the art (or alternatively, a .PSD with several layers to similar effect). 

This is both due to the unreliability of the Artwork section in displaying all the entries, and to allow us to confirm no entry is AI generated.

[h2]Contest Rules[/h2]
[list][*]Create a new piece of artwork ("Entry") related to the game 100% Orange Juice.
[*]Submission period: Until August 31 2025, 14:00 PST.
[*]Entries must be added to the Artworks section of 100% Orange Juice community hub, with the tag #contest2025 and name of the entry, and mailed to [url=support@fruitbatfactory.com]support@fruitbatfactory.com[/url] with the subject "100% Orange Juice Fan Art Contest" according to detailed instructions above.
[*]Entries must be original and not contain any copyrighted material and must adhere to Steam Community guidelines. They may not contain purposeful references outside the Orange Juice games.
[*]AI generated submissions are not accepted in any category. Such entries will be disqualified, and if a winning entry was found to be created using AI afterwards, the placement will be revoked.
[*]Multiple Entries are permitted. 
[*]Text is permitted on the artwork.
[*]Fruitbat Factory will pick the winners at their discretion.
[*]Less than the maximum number of entries may win in a category if there aren't sufficient high quality entries.
[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
By submitting an Entry, the Entrant grants Fruitbat Factory, Ltd a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free worldwide license under all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to use, publish, distribute, copy, modify, translate, create derivative works based upon, make available and otherwise exploit such Entry. Fruitbat Factory, Ltd may do so in any media formats and channels, in any number of copies, without further notice to Entrant, and without the requirement of permission from or payment to Entrant. In addition, Entrant agrees that Fruitbat Factory, Ltd. may use any ideas from any Entry, whether or not Entrant has been awarded a prize in connection with any such Entry.

Let's get drawing!

notes.title: Let's Play Extracurricular Cards!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/bff17878b52016b165da4538c5b490a2cd2cddd2.png"][/img]It's time to open the pack! The new Extracurricular Pack card pack is now available, with 12 new cards, a new card type, and 2 new card keywords in 100% Orange Juice version 3.26 ~ Fluffy and Fuzzy ~!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811450/100_Orange_Juice__Extracurricular_Pack/

The Extracurricular Pack includes 12 new game cards (3 rare, 4 uncommon, 5 common) designed by Orange Juice, and illustrated by Oyama, 490, jo, Kagawa Yusaku, TangoStar, Azuree, and Coffgirl. 

[h2]Banner Cards![/h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/72a5554da2a85037d911b3770fda504e21b9e385.png"][/img]
The Extracurricular Pack introduces a new type of cards: Banners!

These cards can be very strong - the unique aspect of Banner cards is that they provide a game-wide effect until disabled.

Banners are set on the field like face-up Trap cards, but unlike Traps, their effect is active [b]until[/b] a player (or in co-op also Boss or minion) steps on them!

[h3]New Keyword: Trigger[/h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/4aae169f27b5b23b313cc00c1b39c6ac96a325fe.png"][/img]

Cards with the [b]Trigger[/b] effect have a base effect, but if certain conditions are met while carrying them, their description updates into a different one! If the card leaves your hand after triggering, the effect is lost.

You may also note our new tech on the card - dynamic descriptions! Certain parts of the cards are grayed out depending on the active effect. In the screenshot, the Trigger condition has already been met, so the original effect is inactive.

[h3]New Keyword: Repeat[/h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/9cc6d0dcd484d5b6ade2334e4365ff9b7a708517.png"][/img]

[b]Repeat[/b] cards have a very special quality - the effect gets updated each time the card is played during the match! As with Trigger, this ability takes advantage of our new method of coloring the text based on active effect.

Notably, the Repeat effect activates whenever [i]any[/i] player plays a card by the same name, which makes it more likely for higher Repeat levels to activate during a game. The Repeat count is permanent for the whole game, so when you draw a new copy of the card, it will instantly be at the higher Repeat level.

In total, the pack contains: 
[list][*]3 new Banner cards: Protection Fee, Fluffy and Fuzzy, and Feel the Rush with an Energy Drink 
[*]3 new Boost cards: Full Burst, Chef's Special, and Go with the Flow 
[*]2 new Battle cards: Mousse the Thief and Coming Back Stronger 
[*]2 new Event cards: Extreme Alteration and The Greatest Troublemaker Ever 
[*]2 new Gift cards: Look How Long My Arms and Legs Are Now and We're Ticked Off
[*][p]Card illustrations by Oyama, 490, jo, Kagawa Yusaku, Tango, Azuree, and Coffgirl[/list]

[h3]Character Difficulty Ratings[/h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/8101d1a1b299e6e376d0a2e7a601023ec3b54d47.png"][/img]
A new Character Difficulty rating has been added to Character Select menu! This is designed to especially help new players find characters to play that suit their current experience level. All characters are rated 1 to 5 stars, based on complexity of play and dependence on specific card decking.

There are also many fixes and version 3.26 ~ Fluffy and Fuzzy ~, please see [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/6852856365573545750/"]patch notes[/url] for full details!

notes.title: Version 3.25.1 Is Here!
notes.content:
We're excited to present the first major update of our new roadmap!

Version 3.25.1 begins the rerun of our second Season 2 event, Shroom Zoom, makes improvements for new player experience, adds a new OJDex story, balance changes, and more!

[h1]Shroom Zoom![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/70a0088f94d2560b14a1c809196a33d5a8caf7b5.png[/img]
The legendary mushroom hunt is on! The second Season 2 event, Shroom Zoom, is now being rerun for a month, updated with new rewards!

The event can also now be played in all game modes! (Note that the Spores event is not available in Bounty Hunt; instead the Legendary Mushroom may appear in shops to buy!)

Let the great shroomening begin!

[h1]Onboarding Improvements![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/9eae2a6382572a703eeaaa98e0e40c33056a3c13.png[/img]
We've been happy to tackle some long-standing issues in new player experience, and have made several minor improvements to make for a smoother landing.

[list][*]A 5-card booster is now gifted to all new players upon finishing their first game! This pack includes only new cards. They are then notified they can buy more cards in the Shop using stars.
[*]A new mini shop has been added to the lobby screen! You can access it to buy more cards and accessories.

[i]Dev note: We've observed that players often go straight online to play with a friend and they may play many games in a row using only the starting cards. This immediately gives new players more cards to play with in such a scenario, and also clearly communicates how more cards are unlocked - and you can now buy more of them without leaving the lobby.[/i]

[*]Booster Packs for cards can now be purchased in bulk with the newly added GUI! Unlocking a new card will pause the pack opening for viewing the card.
[*]First boot item unlock pop-ups have been re-evaluated and cut down to a minimum. Any DLC content unlock pop-ups now only occur for existing users; if you just bought the game alongside some DLC, you will not get the unlock notifications when starting to play. Previously in some cases new players might have dozens of notifications to click through before getting to the game. 
[*]Replaced the prompt to read the game guide on first launch with an offer to view a new 4 minute tutorial video (English voiceover: [b]Sarah.exe[/b]).
[*]Added a subtle new visual indicator to draw the eye for when players are ready to level up.[/list]

[h1]New OJDex Story![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/497775c73e630442db19cbf026279aa8eece2e4e.png[/img]
A new OJDex side story, [b]Concierge[/b], has been added!

To read the story, unlock 10 accessories or hair colors for [b]Watty [/b]and [b]Pomeranius[/b].

[h2]New Player Plates![/h2]
8 new Avatar backgrounds have been added courtesy of [b]Lvl99 [/b]who recently launched the new [url=https://gamefound.com/en/projects/level-99-games/bullet]Bullet Orange+ board game expansion[/url]!

Four of the plates can be unlocked by reaching player level 99, and four by reaching player level 198.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
For the purposes of better user experience, the following changes have been made:

[b]Kiriko[/b]
Hyper effect updated: "KO all units with 1 HP. [b]Restore 1 lost max HP [/b]and gain 25 stars for each unit KO'd."

[i]Dev note: While Kiriko's performance hasn't been bad, we've seen that her passive tended to lead to a passive playstyle with players not wanting to take permanent HP damage from battle card use despite the great rewards and her extra high HP pool. By adding a way to get max HP back, this mental pressure should be lowered, leading to more interesting engagements.[/i]

[b]Yuki (Dangerous)[/b]
Passive has been updated: "Permanently turn every held card with Pudding in name into Tragedy in the Dead of Night. When someone else triggers your trap, gain 1 Win. Gain no Wins from fighting wild units."
Hyper effect updated: "Draw 3 trap cards from the deck and then set all trap cards in hand on random panels."
Co-op version has also been added to keep her from being a team hazard.

[i]Dev note: We've clarified Yuki's passive to use correct terminology, and in the process she can now gain wins from defeating a Boss. We also increases the usability of her hyper card, which was unnecessarily restrictive for its effect.[/i]

We hope you'll enjoy these changes! We will be posting an updated Roadmap soon.

notes.title: [April Fools'] Chaos Reigns - New Characters, Steam Daily Deal Active!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/18ef5357e243f193ef510a3a49bd4aeb43f34d69.png[/img]
We're happy to present to you another MEGA BIG update in version 1.4.25! And there's no better time to hop on than now - 100% Orange Juice is currently enjoying a historical -86% off discount in a highly exclusive [b]Steam Daily Deal[/b]! We had to deploy a squad of tactical Poppos to secure this slot, so act fast before they get distracted!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/282800/100_Orange_Juice/

[h1]Haruka & Kanata DLC Released![/h1]
The twins of the 100% OJ club are here! Presenting the cheerful gal Haruka, and the school girl genius Kanata! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3587390/100_Orange_Juice__Haruka__Kanata_Character_Pack

[h2]Haruka[/h2]
The younger twin [b]Haruka[/b] is personable and gets along well with anyone! She's voiced by [b]Suguta Hina [/b](Kitagawa Marin in My Dress-up Darling, Kirigaya Touko in BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!)!
[previewyoutube=kq1PISC1TkQ;full][/previewyoutube]

+0/-1/+2, 5 HP, REC:5
Gain -1 ATK at the start of battle for each player currently KO'd.

Hyper (EVENT): Hype Bringer
Lvl: 3, Cost: 10
Effect duration: 3 chapters. Revive all players currently suffering KO with full HP. If another player suffers KO, they recover instantly with full HP. For each player revived, gain their Lvl x 5 stars. This star gain effect can stack.

Character design: [b]Hono[/b]
Character art: [b]Coffgirl[/b]
Card illustration: [b]Coffgirl[/b]

[h2]Kanata[/h2]
The older twin [b]Kanata [/b]is a whimsical genius who knows well her own worth! Kanata is voiced by [b]Takamori Natsumi [/b](Misaki Mei in Another, Maekawa Miku in The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls, Sorakado Ao in Summer Pockets, and many more!) 
[previewyoutube=jHxERnOQL24;full][/previewyoutube]

Character design: [b]Hono[/b]
Character art: [b]Coffgirl[/b]
Card illustration: [b]Coffgirl[/b]

+0/+2/-1, 4 HP, REC: 5
If holding "Intellectual-Sounding Bluff", 50% chance to see the basic card type of any card an opponent draws.

Hyper(BOOST): Intellectual-Sounding Bluff
Lvl: 2, Cost: 10
Target another player. Choose a card type (Battle/Boost/Event/Other), then declare a card type.
If the next card played by target player is the Chosen type: gain 2 Wins and Lvl x 10 stars.
Declared only: take 2 damage. 

[i]Let's liven up the party with the new members of 100% OJ Club![/i]

[h1]Chaos Mode Is Back, More Chaotic Than Ever![/h1]
The great kings of Chaos have descended! Versus mode is now replaced with Chaos Mode until end of the year!!! 5 new Chaos Mutators have also been added!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/691b114e51fa8c7d1c631f7d9564b30163e8b747.png[/img]

[list][*]Bring Down the Tank:
[i]Team up against a random player designated to be the Tank. The three Slayers will win the game if the Tank is defeated, while the Tank must either survive 30 chapters, or have all Slayers KO'd.[/i]
[*]Single Credit:
[i]Revive instantly when KO'd. When revived, change to a randomly designated unit.[/i]
[*]Reversible Fortune:
[i]Start with 200 Stars, and 14 Wins. Win the game by losing Norma levels, and reaching either 0 Stars or 0 Wins. Card cost is halved and cannot exceed 30 stars.[/i]
[*]Tag Team:
[i]Team up with a partner to become the local 100% Orange Juice champion![/i]
[*]Ultimate Tag Team:
[i]Tag Team with a twist! Tag cooldown is reduced to 1 chapter. Tag can be used in battles.[/i][/list]

[h1]All Past and Future Events Have Been Retired![/h1]
In a move much requested by the Poppo community, all the in-game events have been retired, making them accessible to everyone at any time!

Events that were already retired now have full tracking with unlock steps in the new Retired Events section as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/ac9bbfdce7c36711331de56da32bdb5a6e4d6d96.png[/img]

The list of all retired events in the game includes the [i]Poppo Event [/i]and [i]Bounty Hunters[/i].

[h1]OJDex Grows![/h1]
8 new characters have received their OJDex entry: Arnelle, Maynie, chris, Kyupita, Halena, Cook, Bunnizard, Lone Rider, Lost Rogue and Merchant! Character lore and cute pins await those who focus on the character.

[h3]New Side Stories Added![/h3]
A new feature has been added to the game: OJDex Side Stories! Enjoy fun little episodes featuring your favorite characters! To unlock them, simply meet the requirements listed in the new Side Stories section!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/21839ed1892cbbdcc5c2e2169185221e1e1544af.png[/img]

At the beginning there are 3 episodes available to unlock: [b]Family[/b], [b]The Leo's Share[/b], [b]Class Change[/b], [b]The Girl Who Cried Po[/b], [b]]Of Mice and Cats[/b] and [b]Commiseration[/b].

The stories are written by [b]TheVulpineHero1[/b] with story supervision by [b]Hono[/b]. More will be added in future updates over time!

[h2]Other New Features![/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new field event: "Divergence of Opinion". Every 6 chapters, two random players will start an argument and decide it via a 10-round Battle.
[*] Added a random delay to Taunts to avoid players being able to circumvent the lack of in-game chat by communicating with the Taunts using morse code.
[*]Added a bear.
[*] A new stat added on all unit cards: Gullibility. This indicates the likelihood of getting 1-shot from full HP by Seagull. (This stat is Irrespective of all other stats).
[*]Aggressive Chicken increased from 0 to 1.
[*] A new game mode is now unlocked after reaching Lvl 100 with any character: Tower of Tomomo! Fight through a gauntlet of randomly generated challenges of increasing difficulty with your friends to earn a chest of increasing rarity, but beware - KO is permanent! Can you conquer all 99 stages within the time limit?
[*] We have added a few “partner taunts” that are only available when certain characters are in the same game. They will appear in your taunt list in those inconspicuous blank slots that we have been requested to make use of. Can you find them all?
[*] It’s been long enough that most people see PvP Tomomo as the true Tomomo and we have received some confusion from new players regarding her flavor text. To avoid this confusion, we have moved the "Softened" ability to the Campaign Tomomo instead. 
[*]Fixed a bug where Store Manager was not receiving damage from all discard effects.
[*] 100% Orange Juice is now available in e-book format on all the major retailers! An audio book version is also coming.
[*]Added a playable character version of Big Poppo.
[*]Suguri (46 Billion Years) passive updated: When playing a damage dealing Boost/Event card, gain +1 die to your next chocolate roll. You may pay 1.5x its cost (rounded up) to double your cuteness.
[*] Lone Rider: We have assessed that the past balance changes to him may have been too aggressive. To compensate, we have added a new mechanic: Boosting. After his movement roll is exhausted, he may spend 1 heat from his engine and clogging his hand to roll another smaller die to increase his total speed for that turn. Be careful though, if you overheat your engine you will burn out.
[/list]

Full version 1.4.25 patch notes can be found [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybI6_Nrk4UA]on the forums[/url]!

Happy Chaosu!

Fun youth is in danger! Gather at Family Restaurant Pures to figure out how to fix the situation!

A new storyline begins in new "Extracurricular Crisis" event, with a new Tag Team game mode!
Version 3.24 also adds macOS and Steam Timeline support!

[h1]Tag Team![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/c196380873049cb3901b9cd76413d4428e7f8345.png[/img]

A brand new event, Extracurricular Crisis, written by [b]Hono [/b]and illustrated by [b]Tsukino[/b] is now live until [b]December 21[/b]!

Meet new characters and play in the new Tag Team game mode to collect Restaurant Pures stamps and clear the event! (other game modes also progress event but at half the pace).

The Tag Team game mode has players packing not one but TWO characters into the match! The characters can be tagged out every 3 chapters, and will automatically tag out if the player is KO'd! Unleash wild new synergies and clever ploys!

[i]Note that Tag Team game mode is limited to the event duration.[/i]

The event rewards include new costumes, dice, a new field "Pures Stamp Rally", and more!

[b]Alongside the addition of Tag Team, most characters in the game have had new voice lines added.[/b]

[h1]macOS Support Added![/h1]
Good news for our resident apple lovers! 100% Orange Juice now supports macOS as well! 

This is still a new addition and there might be unforeseen issues - if you run into problems, make sure to let us know! We'll be on the lookout to fix those.

[h1]Steam Timeline Support Added![/h1]
100% Orange Juice now also supports the new Steam Timeline feature! This puts markers on the Steam overlay timeline when using Game Recording to show important events, and clearly shows game phases.

[h2]OpenGL Update, New Steam Branches[/h2]
After extensive testing, the OpenGL build has now moved from the Steam Beta to live build! 

There may still be some undiscovered bugs even after over a year of testing, so if you run into those, just make sure to report them to us! We don't expect anyone will be unable to play the game because of the change, but [i]just in case[/i] we've made a new Steam Beta branch that still carries a DirectX build (the previous default), so if for some reason you are unable to play on the OpenGL build, you can switch to that: 
Game Properties -> Betas -> "DirectX_Backup"
This beta will be discontinued once we're confident that players don't have any issues with the OpenGL build.

As we earlier announced, we are now dropping support for x86 architecture. But just for anyone who is unable to play 64 bit games, we've archived the latest version of the game to a new Legacy branch:
Game Properties -> Betas -> "legacy_3.23.1"

This legacy build won't be updated, but you can still play with other people using the same build.

We hope you'll enjoy this major new update!

notes.title: Bounty Hunters Join the New Bounty Hunt!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/e25cc3d7cb3abf2032f50d49bdbe8b6575704910.png[/img]
The time has come! With the big Bounty Hunt game mode rework, we're also launching the first of the "Season 2" event reruns, Bounty Hunters!

[h2]Bounty Hunters[/h2]
The Bounty Hunters rerun is live until August 31! It also comes with new rewards at all milestones, for those who have previously completed the event!

Follow Ellie and Lulu's adventures as you take down the bounties in the event written by [b]Hono [/b]and illustrated by [b]Ogipote[/b]!

This is the 2nd and final time the event gets run normally; after rerunning them, the season 2 events will all be retired!

[h2]Bounty Hunt Rework![/h2]
The rework follows 2 beta phases and countless development hours, and brings with it a massive amount of changes! We'll only list the big ones here, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/6852856365573545750/]full patch notes[/url] on Steam forums!

[h3]Mirages![/h3]
Addressing one of the game mode's biggest pain points, the bounty locations and shops no longer use the Location Shuffle event to reset. Instead, they stay around until certain conditions are met. A new Mirage effect is always marked on a random panel. Once a location or shop is used up, a new one will instantly spawn on this panel marked with Mirage, and a new Mirage will spawn.

[h3]PvP Bounties![/h3]
A new PvP bounty system has been added, enabling an alternative fame-gathering path. This adds public PvP bounties, which can be seen on the new Bounty Board by hovering over the top edge of the screen, and private PvP bounties, which can be acquired from Homes if you hold the Assassin’s Badge (which also gives the player an extra turn of battle against other players).

[h3]Norma Board Perks![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/ccacc5843ee83eb80f5666ab0ae787aea126ecc7.png[/img]
A new Norma Board system lets you choose a permanent bonuses on achieving your Norma.
These are presented at random for the player to pick, and will not appear again once picked. These bonuses vary from stat boosts to discounts and unique abilities.

[h3]Improved Inventory![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/cd9565e2f6b6132a6d62d5285409d4217247dd9d.png[/img]
The inventory graphics have been improved! In addition, each players' inventory can now be viewed at any time by clicking on the new icon on their character plate. Some items can now be used from this menu during your turn. This change removes the earlier Inventory button during Standby.

[h3]Two New Invaders![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/3dfe811bc1f96c737b891e0a2570a6b82b7c475c.png[/img]
Two new invaders, Lost Rogue and Dark Chocolate Mousse, have been added and can be chosen from lobby options.

Invaders now also have the ability to apply Curse to contracts, in addition to their main ability. The curse puts completing that contract on a timer before it is removed.

Each invader now drops a special inventory item with a passive effect upon defeat.

[h3]Shady Merchant![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/9496bf0f72611d1a85a566c3ee3ffdc7321f11e8.jpg[/img]
A new traveling shopkeeper appears - the Shady Merchant runs the Black Market, hosting a plethora of powerful but expensive items; however, you may only buy one Black Market item in a game.

[h3]Several Mechanics Adjusted![/h3]
There are several other specific mechanical issues that have been addressed in various ways: Fish-a-Fish event now grants fame; Wins give stars upon landing on homes, a new catch-up mechanic has been added that gives extra contracts for lower Norma players, Bounties can be re-challenged after a defeat... the list is too long for the announcement, so please make sure to read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/6852856365573545750/]patch notes[/url]!

We hope you'll enjoy the new and shiny Bounty Hunt mode!

notes.title: 504403158265497090 Points, or A Day in the Life of a Save File - Devlog
notes.content:
We're happy to share with you another devlog by [b]Rapha[/b], this time about the recently implemented big save rework, why it was necessary and what went into it! Hope you enjoy reading it.

[h2]The Perils of Binary[/h2]

In the realm of video game development, preserving a player's progress is paramount. This is where game saves come in, capturing the state of a game so it can be resumed later. However, the methods used to store these save games can significantly impact their susceptibility to corruption, be it by external or internal factors.

[h2]The problem
[/h2]
[b]100% Orange Juice[/b] since time immemorial used binary storage, it used to be the go to for this kind of data when processing power and storage space weren't plenty available. It's more efficient to write, to read, and uses less space in disk. But this efficiency comes at a cost, it's easy to mess up. It's why we've added more and more ways the game backups your saves at various points over time, to make sure players have some backup to return to if their save with years of progress gets corrupted.

Now let's imagine a theoretical game, [b]Poppo Saves The World[/b]! Let's imagine it as a beat-em-up, where you go around fighting enemies, one after the other, until you win and save the world. Lets supposed you have the following section of data that needs to be saved:

- Wins

- Points

- Last stage cleared

Lets supposed you have 10 victories, 393939 points and the last stage cleared as stage 7. Let's imagine you used 64 bit values for everything. So:

|Data | Explanation|

|--|--|

|0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 | 10 in hex padded to 64 bits|

|D3 02 06 00 00 00 00 00 | 393939 in hex padded to 64 bits |

|07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 | 07 in hex padded to 64 bits |

In the file would be:

    0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 D3 02 06 00 00 00 00 00 07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

But then you introduce abilities to the game, you decide to store it as a single byte, that will keep if you have each of the 8 abilities available unlocked, one in each bit.

|8|7|6|5|4|3|2|1|

|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|

|0|0|0|0|0|0|0|0|

Let's suppose your player unlocked only the first one so it's a 1, so in binary:

|8|7|6|5|4|3|2|1|

|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|

|0|0|0|0|0|0|0|1|

You inadvertently decided to write it between wins and points, so you would have the new binary:

|Data | Explanation|

|--|--|

|0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 | 10 in hex padded to 64 bits|

|01 | 01 in hex, it's a single byte |

|D3 02 06 00 00 00 00 00 | 393939 in hex padded to 64 bits |

|07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 | 07 in hex padded to 64 bits |

In the file would be:

    0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 D3 02 06 00 00 00 00 00 07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

And as logically implied, you would change your reading code to expect that too! But then comes the problem! Your old save doesn't agree. Let's see what your game would read from an old save.

    0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 D3 02 06 00 00 00 00 00 07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

It expects 8 bytes for the Wins, so it reads 8 bytes:

    0A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

That reads to 10! Seems ok! Up until now everything have gone correctly.

But then it tries to read the byte for abilities...

    D3

D3 is byte, your game doesn't know if it is valid or not, it's binary, it believes in the binary. Let's look at it for a bit, in binary:

|8|7|6|5|4|3|2|1|

|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|

|1|1|0|1|0|0|1|1|

So not only the first, but the second, fifth, seventh and eighth abilities are unlocked?!? Wow! That's a problem.

Let's continue, more 8 bytes:

    02 06 00 00 00 00 00 07

That's [b]504403158265497090 [/b]points... That's definitely not what was written originally. By reading that byte that wasn't there, you misaligned the whole thing, and now your player has more points than literally the universe has seconds of life. And then you continue, last 8 bytes:

    00 00 00 00 00 00 00

But that's not 8, you only got 7! If you really try to read that, you will get an unexpected behavior. What happens depends on what system, what processor and what contingencies are in place. In some systems you may read a byte from memory that has nothing to do with your save, in others you may read some leftover on the memory bus, in some you will crash... The ideal behavior would be the crashing.

But lets supposed it didn't. It loaded.

Now you have:

10 victories

5 abilities unlocked

[b]504403158265497090 [/b]points

[i]And never cleared a single stage[/i]

If this happens to your user, they won't understand a single bit of what's happening, will they?

[h2]The conclusion[/h2]

You must be thinking now, "Well, that's easy, just don't mess up". Yeah, but that's easier said than done, with less than a dozen of information to save, and total control over it you can't commit this mistake.

But what about having 200000 different bits of data that need to be read and written correctly, by code written over 15 years, written by different people, with different designs in mind, written by functions in different files, some keeping proper spacing between data, with spare data for future use, some not. That was our situation! Years of updates adding numerous incongruities that we didn't account for, despite fighting against it all day.

Yeah, that's a design flaw, and that's why we are fixing it, starting with this step! 100% Orange Juice is a bigger game than one might imagine, and such huge code base being kept alive by less than 10 people is nothing less than a miracle driven by passion and willpower over the years.

[h2]The solution[/h2]

We won't enter into detail, because our new save system not only is 100% reliable but has a good number of protection layers against people editing it. But firstly, if your save was changed externally, it won't load.

This is to avoid the game crashing if your storage is faulty and some bit flipped. That's why the backups are now more important than ever, if your main save corrupted, it won't load, no one will be able to restore it, its gone forever. The game won't even try to read it.

But not only that, now generally speaking, each bit of data inside the save games has a proper name to address them.

Let's bring the example from before:

[list]
[*] Wins
[*] Points
[*] Last stage cleared
[/list]

Now we build a database in memory, naming each value in a proper structure before writing it to the save. So it would be something like this:

    wins: 10, points: 393939, last_stage_cleared: 7

For reading, you simply search for the value name and loads the value attributed to it: wins → 10, points → 393939, and it goes on.

If you add a new value:

    wins: 10, abilities: 1, points: 393939, last_stage_cleared: 7

It doesn't matter, you aren't reading in sequence, you have a proper system to encode and decode the values and search them by name. If abilities doesn't exist on the save, you load the default value and go on.

This basically clears the future from unwanted data changes, but nothing in life is a perfect solution. We still need to load the old save, and if that's corrupted, the new one will be too, as the old save system trusted above everything else what was written, in the exact order it was.

The game also may after some update write something wrong, that's a bug, it can happen, it doesn't mean the save is corrupted stricto sensu, but in lato sensu the data was handled wrongly, so that's still a bug, that's still a thing that needs to be reported.

So if after the save conversion on the last big update, you got more dice than the universe has seconds of life, the best we can suggest is contacting us! We will do the best in our power to fix your old corrupted save. But be aware there may be some times that it's impossible (mainly if you didn't play for the last 7~10 years, the amount of uncounted problems can be beyond any repair), but even in this horrific situation, talk with us, say what you hold dear about your old save, and we might be able to find a path that will make you happy.

The old guard has entered the (school) building! The two veterans from Flying Red Barrel, Bourbon and Grain, are now available to play for owners of the Bourbon & Grain Character Pack! The School Crashers event has also returned!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989310/100_Orange_Juice__Bourbon__Grain_Character_Pack/

[h2]Bourbon[/h2]
The soulful pilot longs for a time when the skies are free again. Leader of the Resistance from Flying Red Barrel, [b]Bourbon [/b]brings unique tactical skills into play. His gruff voice is perfected by Mamiya Yasuhiro (Hugo Kupka in Final Fantasy XVI, Gigantomachia in Boku no Hero Academia, Viviano Westwood in JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 6: Stone Ocean Part 2)! 

[previewyoutube=ZZgd9NFh_mw;full][/previewyoutube]
+0/+1/-1, 7 HP, REC 6
Every time you take damage in battle, lose 1 max HP (down to 3) until KO'd.

Hyper: Heart of Resistance (BOOST)
Lvl 2, Cost: 20
Target another active player. Next time they are challenged or challenge a unit while you are active, take their place in the battle. Gain +3 ATK, DEF and EVD at the start of the battle. You may only have this effect on one player at a time.

Character Design: [b]Junpyon[/b]
Character Art: [b]Coffgirl[/b]
Hyper Illustration: [b]Junpyon [/b]

[h2]Grain[/h2]
Malt's right hand man at the Guild, [b]Grain [/b]will give your performance a cool evaluation, but he can also bring out some serious firepower! Grain is voiced by [b]Yamazaki Takumi[/b] (Kawakami Bansai in Gintama, Isamu in Macross Plus, Nano in Togainu no Chi, and many more!)

[previewyoutube=iOETvPg471o;full][/previewyoutube]
+1/+2/-2, 5 HP, REC: 6
-1 MOV. Gain a Cannonball Counter upon playing a card.

Hyper: All Guns at the Ready (Event)
Lvl 3, Cost: 30
Pay all stocked Cannonball Counters. Deal 1 damage to a random enemy. If the enemy is KO'd, gain 1 Win and Stars equal to 10x their level. Repeat this once for every Cannonball Counter paid.

Character Design: [b]Junpyon[/b]
Character Art: [b]Coffgirl[/b]
Hyper Illustration: [b]Junpyon [/b]

[h2]School is Back in Session![/h2]
The anniversary fun continues with a much requested re-run of the School Crashers event! Collect pieces of NoName in fun Playground minigames to clear the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/a3a4b8596477d40b66d13f751d4382509f497012.png[/img]

The event runs until June 16!

School Crashers has no new rewards this time, and is automatically finished if you have done so previously.

[h2]New Save System![/h2]
While this update may not be flashy, it'll hopefully make the game more robust to play for a long, long time! We've overhauled the game's save system with the new system we trialed in the second Bounty Hunt beta.

The save files are now found in a "save" folder in the game's installation folder. They are further separated into folders by your Steam user ID, and all 3 user profiles have a separate save file. The big benefit of this is that family sharing and similar scenarios will no longer overwrite your save file as it's based on your Steam ID. The new format of the save files should also make them way more safe against save corruption, keeping your progress more secure.

[h2]Graphics Engine Upgrade[/h2]
The graphics engine in 100% Orange Juice has been overhauled to use OpenGL 3.3! It's a big change which completes the removal of any windows-only code from the game, but you shouldn't notice any immediate difference from it.

In the future, this makes new effects and features possible, possibly even new kinds of mods. Eventually this will enable us to release the game on other platforms besides Windows as well! 

Full patch notes for the update can be found on the Steam forums, as usual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/17d9d2836e55522676f1887c12d3f182efa617f5.png[/img]

notes.title: [April Fools] Spring Mayhem Ensues in version 3.14 ~CutiePie~!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/0385bef9bacdb5fb272f9646f35dcfbed492c009.png[/img]
After long preparation, we're excited to kick off Season 3 of 100% Orange Juice in the roll-out of version 3.14 ~CutiePie~!

[h2]Season 3![/h2]
Season 3 kicks off with an introductory event, School Grudges!
Marie and Kai don't seem to have anything in common. Marie is a popular girl with a strong personality, while Kai sort of fades into the background. But both of them are hiding something about themselves. Because her mom works full time, Marie has to spend most of her free time caring for her younger sisters and herself. Meanwhile, Kai is hiding a more nerdy side - he listens to idol music wherever he goes, and carries a deck of cards that he never shows anyone.

The two might not have much in common, but they do have camouflage. That's enough to spark a beautiful relationship.

[h2]The Old Guard Is Here![/h2]
Two long-awaited new characters slide into 100% Orange Juice! Suguri (46 Billion Yen) and Sumiko are now playable for owners of the Old Guard Pack!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NKddat4LaNY][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/a5828a9572b7065e56f5300c0d1e3407707dacfc.png[/img][/url]

Create chaos on the battlefield with Suguri and Sumiki's unique mechanics! 

[h3]Suguri (46 Billion Yen)[/h3]
HP 5, ATK +1, DEF +2, EVD -2, REC 6
Gain a Stock Counter upon playing a card.

All Stocks at the Ready (BOTTLE)
Level 3, Cost: 30
Pay all Stock Counters owned. If you have more Stock than your opponent, you buy the company and defeat them. Repeat this as many times as the Stock Counters paid.

[h3]Sumuka[/h3]
0/+1/-1, 7 HP, 6 REC
Every time you take a damage, your current HP goes down by 1.

Heart of Dorkness (BOOT)
Lvl 2, Cost: 20
Target another active player. Next time they are challenged or challenge a unit, play a game of Tetris (the hard one). If you win, gain 1 star. On game over, lose the game.

[h2]Chaos Mode Added![/h2]
A new Chaos Mode has been added to the game! The mode is permanent and we promise a minimum of 5 years of support for it, including 2 new game modes, a battle pass, new characters, a helpline and increased banner rates. Chaos Mode will be retired on April 30. Thank you for your support!

Players finishing the Chaos Mode will receive a Mikky Mousse (Steamboat Willie version) skin for Marie Poppo.

[h2]Other Changes in Version 3.14[/h2]
[list][*]Added new shop to Bounty Hunt mode: Stockbroker, which sells new Share Cards (RBIT, WRDA, HBBY) which function as cards whose purpose is to be resold back at star amounts that will vary throughout the course of the game. A Stock Market graph has also been added to the GUI to display current market trends for the convenience of all players.
[*]Added Idle Mode: In this mode, you can only spectate, while your avatar of destruction plays against other CPU-controlled characters. You can also bet on the winner (in select countries). The winner gains stuff.
[*]OJ Chess has been added! We're not quite sure what it does yet, but it's looking cool! 
[/list]

Balance
[list][*]Self Destruct causes you to always roll 6 in battle.
[i]Dev note: This is just a description change. The functionality is unchanged.[/i]

[*]Store Manager (Boss) now gains +2 EVD at 1 HP.
[i]Dev note: We found this boss was massively underperforming compared to the rest in our sample of 2 games played.[/i]

[*]If you have 5 stacks of Golden Egg as Chicken, you can summon Eggs-odia and automatically win the game.
[i]Dev note: eggcellent.[/i]

[*]Sweet Creator has resigned as CEO of the Sweet Gods due to increased public scrutiny for being under investigation for connections to organized crime, counterfeiting and willfully disregarding FDA regulations.
[i]Dev note: We take all rules and regulations seriously.[/i]
[/list]

Fixes:
[list][*]Fixed a Co-op issue where Big Poppo's minion would erroneously show up as the boss.
[*]Fixed an issue where Star Breaker would erroneously win the game when landing on a home panel with 14+ wins.
[*]Fixed an issue where Chaos units could not be leaked into other modes.
[/list]

Full patch notes can be read on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/6852856365573545750/]Steam forums[/url]! Happy crawling chaos!

Version 3.15 also includes several balance changes, namely:

[b]Mother Poppo[/b]
Mother Power had the following change:
"If the effect ends or is replaced while active, heal all damage taken during the effect."
->
"If the effect ends or is replaced while active, heal to full HP."

[i]Dev note: Mother Poppo was struggling with maintaining her HP which made it hard to benefit both from her passive and her Hyper. This card both allows her to avoid hanging on at low HP (and being easy pickings), and to use a second Hyper to top up her HP in an emergency. We believe that'll allow Poppo to win more, as Tomomo intended.[/i]

[b]Tomato & Mimyuu[/b]
Mimyuu had the following change:
"Revive as Tomato and act on revival."
->
"Revive as Tomato. When you do, you may challenge any enemies on the same panel."

Tomato had the following addition to her passive:
"Lose 1/3 stars when KO'd in battle."

[i]Dev note: Tomato & Mimyuu have long been in our sights for a small improvement. The main pain point with the characters came from them not really delivering on the core concept where Tomato takes revenge on those who bully Mimyuu, as her acting on revival would result in her running ahead of the player who KO'd Mimyuu, and being easily subjected to chain KO instead. This change should make players think twice about picking on Mimyuu. However we also acknowledge that Tomato's stats aren't very high either and even an attempt at payback carried great risk, so the star loss change will make her revenge more viable.[/i]

[b]Suguri (46 Billion Years)[/b]
Suguri's passive had the following change
"When choosing a damage dealing Boost/Event card to play, you may pay 1.5x its cost (rounded up) to double its damage on use. If you do, gain +1 die to your next movement roll."
->
"When playing a damage dealing Boost/Event card, gain +1 ATK until end of turn and +1 die to your next movement roll. You may pay 1.5x its cost (rounded up) to double its damage."

[i]Dev note: Doubling a damage card's power is no longer necessary to trigger the rest of the passive bonus. Suguri (46 Billion Years) is another character we've long wanted to buff, but it took time to decide how to approach her. After much discussion, we felt the requirement to double a damage card's cost to receive the passive bonus was hampering Suguri's gameplay both in terms of players spending more stars for little gain and hurting their progress, and limiting their options in doing a custom amount of damage to potential targets to bring them down to low HP. With the removal of that restriction and the addition of a further +1 ATK to the ability, we believe she will be a force to be reckoned with on the field.[/i]

These were the first balance changes of 2024, but we hope to also make them more regularly in the future, and we already have several characters under discussion.

[h2]New Player Plates![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/b3a2db9e93392ce8bcf795383ff46c16356ef40b.png[/img]
Owners of the soundtrack DLC now unlock a new player plate for each soundtrack (Ultimate Weapon Girl, Pudding Pop, and Star Baker Breaker), based on their cover art!

Full patch notes for version 3.15 can be viewed on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/6852856365573545750/]Steam forums[/url].

We hope you enjoy these new additions to the game, and look forward to more!

notes.title: Time to Hunt the Bounties Again!
notes.content:
The even longer awaited second wave of the Bounty Hunt beta is now live for a 2-week period! We've made many big and small changes based on the survey results from the first beta in the spring, and hope you'll like them!

[h2]New Mirage System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/5234808d6995f7587548771e7c1d69b7498276c0.png[/img]
The biggest individual change is that the bounty locations no longer use the Location Shuffle event to reset. Instead, they stay around until the bounty is defeated. A new Mirage effect is always marked on a random panel. Once a location moves, it will instantly spawn on this panel marked with Mirage, and a new Mirage location will spawn. This change has taken a lot of work, and we hope it addresses the most core issues with the game mode and makes the transition from quests into bounties smoother than ever!

7 turns after appearing, each shop will turn dark, and that means that after the next visit they will get shuffled to the Mirage.

Since this change made the first beta's Forecast system unnecessary, it has been removed.

[h2]Curses![/h2]
Invaders now have a new ability to curse contracts! This works similarly to Harbinger's Doom, but instead of targeting a player with the threat of a KO, they mark a contract held in the player's hand. Once the timer on it reaches 0, the contract is removed. The curses can be removed just like Doom.

Harbinger has a 30% chance when he uses his ability to use Curse instead of Doom. The Lost Rogue applies Curse on any hits from his leap attacks.

[h2]Improved Inventory UI[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/cd9565e2f6b6132a6d62d5285409d4217247dd9d.png[/img]
The inventory graphics have been improved! In addition, each players' inventory can now be viewed at any time by clicking on the new icon on their character plate. Items can only be used during your turn.

This change removes the earlier Inventory button during Standby.

[h2]Stronger Assassin's Badge[/h2]
Holding the Assassin's Badge now gives its wearer an additional turn of battle against other players, making hunting down lively prey for contracts that much easier!

[h2]New Level-Up Perks![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/e736c2ec07c6193de2e3a84230b24e8b51a4827a.png[/img]
2 new Norma perks have been added: [b]Commander [/b]and [b]Home Defender.[/b] 
[list]
[*] [b]Home Defender [/b]fortifies your own Home Panel so that it deals 2 damage to any other player stopping on it.
[*] [b]Commander [/b]gives the player the option to manually control their Follower, as well as increases its max HP by 2 and healing the follower to full if one exists.
[/list]

[h2]New Save System[/h2]
The Beta has also implemented an all-new, more robust save system to avoid the persistent issues people have with their save files! 

The saves during the Beta will be in a new "save" folder, and the usual save.dat file is not used beyond reading your initial save data.

If you spot any issues with your save data during the beta (things not saving properly, or something strange happened to your earlier save data when imported to the new format), please let us know!

[h2]How to Join[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/8996df995c1e15eba2e55fe627278327bbc061ed.png[/img]

To participate, go to the properties of 100% Orange Juice in your Steam Library, then BETAS page -> select "beta - Public Beta" from the dropdown menu.

[b]Progress in the beta version is separate from your main save and will not interfere with that when you return to the normal game build.[/b]

Refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/5/3780247517067115373/]this post on the Steam forums[/url] for a list of the current changes! You can also report any issues or give feedback on the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/5/]BH Beta Feedback forum[/url], or through the #100-oj-beta channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/fruitbatfactory]Discord server[/url].

notes.title: Treasure Awaits!
notes.content:
The summer events continue with an all-new "Treasure Tails" event, which follows the ending of "Path to Secrets"!

[i]After fighting Arnelle's group to be the first to reach the lakeside shrine with its rumored treasure, Ellie and Lulu make it inside with their companions, only for a triggered trap to plunge them all into its depths. What awaits them in the darkness...?[/i]

The event is live until October 20.

[h2]Treasure Tails[/h2]
To progress in the event, there's only one thing you need to do: Defeat Mousse, Mousse and even more Mousse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/3b95eb2b154007be16952c2083e46766dbe1ca67.jpg[/img]
The event uses a modified Bounty Hunt ruleset with numerous changes, including lowered Norma requirements, 50% cheaper shops, and an extra +1 hand size. Three bounties are available to fight: Mousse (2 fame), Key Lime Mousse (3 fame) and Strawberry Mousse (4 fame). In addition, completing a quest will begin a fight against a 2 HP Mousse instead of simply giving 2 fame.

The event mode also incorporates some key changes from the earlier Bounty Hunt beta, including removal of quest stacking, and not being able to get duplicates of same contract offered on a home.

Last but not(?) least, a new invader, Dark Chocolate Mousse, will appear and... keep running away while siphoning off players' stars. 

The event can be completed in either the event mode, or in normal Bounty Hunt (via fighting the Mousse bounty).

Event story: [b]Hono[/b]
Ending illustration: [url=https://twitter.com/Usanekorin]UsanekoRin[/url]

We hope you'll enjoy the continuation of Ellie's journey!

notes.title: Celebrating 10 Year English Version Anniversary with New "Memory Lane" Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/6e82c33cc0e7161d1ea347e50ef7b18a2ac4e43c.png[/img]
It's been 10 [strike]000 [/strike]years! On [b]September 10, 2013[/b], we released the English version of 100% Orange Juice, and unleashed Poppo to the world. Not to be confused with the actual Steam release of [b]May 16, 2014[/b], which we will be celebrating next year!

In celebration of this auspicious day, we're launching another unique contest: [b]Memory Lane[/b]!

[h1]Memory Lane Contest[/h1]
For this contest, you don't need to make anything new! In fact, you're not allowed to! Instead we're asking you to dig into your lost archives for submissions! We are looking for the best video clips and screenshots from throughout the years! Dust off those old hard drives!

[b]16 categories total!
The winner of each category will receive a Fruitbat Factory game of their choice (some restrictions apply), and the Contest Winner pin!

In addition, we will be featuring chosen entries in a celebratory video we'll prepare for the 100% Orange Juice Steam anniversary on May 16, 2024!

The contest is open until the end of October 10, 2023 (PDT).
[/b]

Please read the submission instructions carefully as they include some new detail to make for smooth processing.

All submissions should be e-mailed to support@fruitbatfactory.com with the subject "Memory Lane Contest Entry". 

Videos should be named [Year]_[Scene number]_[Entrant name], for example "2014_2_PhleBuster.mp4" as a submission for the Craziest Co-Op Moment Scene.

Screenshots should be named [Year]_[Category number]_[Entrant name], for example "2013_3_PhleBuster.jpg" as a submission for the Funniest Glitch Category entry.

All entries may be attached to the same e-mail, but aren't required to.

[h2]Era[/h2]
[list]
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of 2013-2014
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of 2015-2016
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of 2017-2018
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of 2019-2020
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of 2021-2022
[*] Most 100% Orange Juice Moment of January to August 2023
[/list]

Both screenshot and video entries are automatically submitted to their corresponding Era category in addition to their main category.

[h2]Video Submissions[/h2]
A video can be submitted to one [b]Scene [/b]category. In addition, all videos are automatically entered in the corresponding [b]Era [/b]category.

Note that video entries are limited to [b]1 per Category per person[/b] - so pick your best one carefully!

[h3]Scene[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Best Minigame Moment
[*] Craziest Co-Op Moment
[*] Funniest Bug Moment
[*] Luckiest Moment
[*] Unluckiest Moment
[*] Most Dramatic 
[/olist]

[h3]Restrictions on submissions[/h3]
[list]
[*] The entry must be something you personally recorded.
[*] The same entry can only be submitted for one Scene category. One entry may be submitted per Scene category, but one entrant can only win once.
[*] Video entries must be max 1 minute in length.
[*] They can be hosted on any safe platform that allows direct download (eg not on YouTube, or an alternative download needs to be provided in addition to YouTube), and download link should be provided instead of attaching the video. Videos of less than 5MB in size can be attached directly to the submission email.
[*] Accepted video formats: .mp4, .wmv, .mov, .mkv, .mpg, .mpeg
[*] Just timestamping a video is not accepted, it needs to be up to 1 minute in length.
[*] Recorded voiceover that took place during the clip is accepted.
[*] No copyrighted material outside of 100% OJ properties accepted on the videos (including in mods)
[*] Videos should be named [Year]_[Scene number]_[Entrant name], for example "2014_2_PhleBuster.mp4" as a submission for the Craziest Co-Op Moment Scene.
[*]If any entry is afterwards found to be breaking the rules, it will be disqualified and the prizes will be revoked.
[/list]

[h2]Screenshot Submissions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/025470ccafa250abcfe5c25397a7955b0a9dd755.png[/img]
Screenshots can be submitted for one of 4 Scene categories!
A screenshot can be submitted to one [b]Scene [/b]category. In addition, all screenshots are automatically entered in the corresponding [b]Era [/b]category.

[h3]Scene[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Best Moment Before a Disaster
[*] Most Painful Moment
[*] Funniest Glitch
[*] The Best Tale Told by a Single Picture
[/olist]

Note that screenshot entries are limited to [b]1 per Category per person[/b] - so pick your best one carefully!

[h3]Restrictions on submissions[/h3]
[list][*] The entry must be something you personally screenshotted. It must be captured directly from the game, and not from video footage.
[*] The same entry can only be submitted for one Category. One entry may be submitted per category, but one entrant can only win once.
[*] Screenshot entry should be attached to the email.
[*]Accepted screenshot formats: .jpg, .png, .bmp
[*] No copyrighted material outside of 100% OJ properties accepted on the screenshots (including in mods)
[*] Screenshots should be named [Year]_[Category number]_[Entrant name], for example "2013_3_PhleBuster.jpg" as a submission for the Funniest Glitch Category entry.
[*] If any entry is afterwards found to be breaking the rules, it will be disqualified and the prizes will be revoked.[/list]

[i]Fruitbat Factory reserves the right to not use any of the Entries for a given category, if they deem none of the submissions are appropriate for it.[/i]

notes.title: Summer Continues with a Fishing Trip!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/d6092e3597a7964d304d39002d01d68c1e82d3bf.png[/img]
Enjoy a refreshing trip to the nature in a rerun of the Master Anglers event! Now live for 2 weeks, until September 11!

This summer event has no new rewards and lets people who previously missed or didn't finish the event to collect the prizes again. Instead, all players receive 4 Arcade Tokens and not the usual 3 during the event for more pet goodness.

[h2]New Bonus Event Rotation[/h2]
A permanent new Bonus Event rotation has been added to the game! 

Every two weeks will see a 3 day bonus event, starting on Tuesday or Friday in turn! These bonus events can overlap with other active events. 

List of rotating bonus events:
[list][*]2x EXP
[*]All Units
[*]All Fields 
[*]Double Drop
[*]Double Stars (new event)[/list]
The rotation will start with a Double EXP event on September 1st!

[b]Balance[/b]
[list][*]Mimyuu (Jailbird) HP lowered to 4 (down from 5).
[*]Mimyuu (Jailbird)'s Attacker rank has been reduced from A to B in Co-op.
[*]Mimyuu (Jailbird)'s Guardian rank has been  reduced from B to C in Co-op.
[*]Mimyuu (Jailbird)'s Avenger rank has been reduced from A to C in Co-op.[/list]
[i]Dev note: the monstrous strength of Mimyuu required Sora to call in reinforcements to stop her escape. A frantic chase ensued, exhausting Mimyuu's reserves of liberated snacks, and necessitating more frequent returns to her secret base to restock. These trips are expected to slow down her escape attempts in the future.[/i]

[list][*]Added a Co-op variation of Forced Revival: Point cost 5, Max 1. Restores all KO'd units to half HP, rounded up (instead of to 1).[/list]
[i]This change is expected to make Forced Revival less one dimensional in Co-op, where it was unduly strong against some bosses and mostly useless outside of them. It is now also a powerful support tool to keep your party alive on harder difficulties.[/i]

[b]Other Changes in version 3.13.3[/b]
[list][*]Removed DLC check for unlocking Halena & Cook earmuffs.
[*]All Fields event now applies in single player as well.
[*]Fixed Swimming Coach's attempted sabotage (Swimming Coach plate border covering other players' co-op roles on CPU customization screen).
[*]Fixed CPUs being able to deck multiple copies of Max 1 cards.
[*]Made consistency fixes to the following card & unit descriptions to make their effect more accurate and easier to understand: Big Poppo, Highway Robbery, From the Abyss, Chaos Poppo, From the Chaotic Abyss, Krilalaris (Pajamas).
[*]Fixed performance issue when changing cosmetics at the deck selection screen.
[*]Changed the internal logic of mixer randomization (no noticeable effect to players apart from mixers resetting upon update).
[*]Disabled costume display for other players on the CPU selection screen..
[*]On team mini-preview under the Customize-CPU option, mini-preview now updates face coordinates correctly when selecting a character through Random.[/list]

Enjoy catching the big one!

notes.title: Versiones Hotfix Live!
notes.content:
[list][*]Fixed Star Collector not working in co-op.
[*]Fixed "Loved by Fans" achievement not being triggered by Miracle panels.
[*]Binding Chains' "Bound" now has its proper duration in Co-op.
[*]Tactical Retreat no longer deflates Swimming Coach.
[*]Voice lines for Mimyuu (Jailbird) passing units while using Make-Believe Prison Break no longer procure against allies and now only for enemies.
[*]Fixed card animations delaying the game-end trigger after Star Devourer runs out of stars.
[*]Fixed Encore triggering a Boss encounter after Boss panels have been reverted to Encounter.
[*]Fixed Sherry Special Line 4 not triggering against fighting Teotoratta.
[*]Spectators can now see taunts.
[*]Fixed Sweet Maker's Magic not removing the Red Bean Miracle Ice Cream floating gift indicator when used by non-Sweet-Maker.
[*]Fixed Sweet Creator, Maker, Blogger and Mio (Festive) not having their wings in the arcade.
[*]Disabled cosmetics and pet display for other players on the CPU selection screen. Host's cosmetics are now properly updated on both CPU selection screen and mini role preview.
[*]Fixed mixer bonuses for Goo and Spores, now correctly and respectively Negative and Neutral.
[*]Adjusted Make-Believe Prison Break's description to mention traveling rather than traversing for clarity.
[*]Every star gain and star loss effect targeted at Big Poppo will now be redirected to the boss that summoned her instead.
[*]Big Poppo now starts with 0 stars.
[*]Players no longer gain an extra 25 stars if Big Poppo is KO'd by out-of-combat damage
Fixed player minions not giving stars taken from damaging Star Devourer or KOing Big Poppo.
[*]Fixed visual issue of overlapping co-op level display on decking screen.
[*]Adjusted Tequila's description to mention that Pirate Crew Members are wild units.
[*]Big Poppo now pays out 100 stars and 3 wins if KO'd by non-player events such as Minelayer, Air Raid, Bomber, etc.
[*]Fixed tutorial textures piling up, causing new pages to be added with text from other events.[/list]

notes.title: Summer Calls to the Pool!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/810d4a834fee0e1a79b2c4486a0b425e63939296.png[/img]
Hope everyone (in the summer regions) is having a nice summer! We're happy to bring back the long-awaited Pool Party event in 100% Orange Juice to cool you off!

Take on Mio's monstrosity of Swimming Coach in the event to unlock new rewards alongside the old ones!

[b]The event is live until August 15.[/b]

The event has a global counter toward clearing the event, and it can be progressed at 50% rate by fighting other co-op bosses in addition to the Swimming Coach. Players have a new personal goal of 5 games to unlock the event's ending and rewards.

Sunglasses can also be unlocked for all characters during the event.

[b]Other changes in version 3.13.2[/b]
[list][*]Increased the cost of Make-Believe Prison Break from 0 to 13.[/list]
[i]Dev note: Rewards don't come without sacrifice. The tough little jailbird was proving a bit more successful in her jailbreak attempts than intended. This change isn't expected to fully limit her potential, but it was evident she should have to fork over some stars to aid in her escape plans. Sora is keeping an eye on her behavior.[/i]

Have a nice current season!

notes.title: Mimyuu and Krilalaris Break Free!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/e14fa3bdc6f473fb88b3d32d42db59e1a0fb14b1.png[/img]
It's time to break out of your cage! The [b]Waruda Prison Break Pack [/b]adds [b]Mimyuu (Jailbird)[/b] and [b]Krilalaris (Pajamas)[/b], with a wacky new campaign to boot!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456760/100_Orange_Juice__Waruda_Prison_Break_Pack/

[h1]Mimyuu (Jailbird)[/h1]
Hardened by life in the joint, the tough cookie [b]Mimyuu (Jailbird)[/b] joins the cast! She is voiced by [b]Kita Natsuki[/b] who revisits her role as Mimyuu with all the oomph you could hope for!

[previewyoutube=RL32U8a-eyQ;full][/previewyoutube]
+1/0/+1, 5 HP, REC 4
When KO’d in battle, move to your Home panel.

Hyper: Make-Believe Prison Break (BOOST)
Level 1, Cost: 0
Move to your Home panel without activating it. Cannot be challenged or be the target of other players' Boost cards. Immune to Trap cards, instant KO effects, and card damage from other players. Roll 2 dice for movement. Effect ends after traversing 20 panels.

Character Design: [b]Hono[/b]
Character Art: [b]Yulay Devlet[/b]
Hyper illustration: [b]Coffgirl[/b]

[h1]Krilalaris (Pajamas)[/h1]
Enter Mimyuu's trusted partner-in-crime, the somnolent [b]Krilalaris (Pajamas)[/b] whose dark aura is sealed into her haunted dreams! [b]Momokawa Rika[/b] returns as the voice of Krilalaris, with an amazing wakefulness-defying performance! 

[previewyoutube=II2YRDQoMqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
0/+1/0, 4 HP, REC 6.
Cannot use the Evade command in battle. If you would suffer 1 damage while using the Defend command, cancel that damage and pay your Lvl x stars to the opponent.

Hyper: Threats to My Slumber (GIFT)
Lvl 1, Cost: 13
When you cancel exactly 1 damage in battle while holding this card, gain a stock of Waking. (Max 4. Does not stack.) Transform to When My Slumber Breaks upon use.

Hyper: When My Slumber Breaks (EVENT)
Lvl 2, Cost: 13
Deal X+1 damage to all other players and the Boss, where X is your Waking count. Remove all Waking stocks. Gain 1 HP for every 2 Waking stock removed.

Character Design: [b]Hono[/b]
Character Art: [b]Yulay Devlet[/b]
Hyper illustration: [b]Ikuse[/b]

[h1]New Campaign![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/3f1f804423869ac2a51e04366bab88b76a884858.png[/img]
And that's not all! The DLC comes with a wacky new campaign "Waruda Prison Break" that offers 6 episodes of entertainment, supervised by [b]Hono[/b] and written by [b]TheVulpineHero1[/b]! Campaign ending is illustrated by the talented [b]jo[/b], and clearing it unlocks a new field, [b]Circus[/b] (can also be purchased in the in-game shop by those who don't own the DLC)!

[list]

[*]Updated the game loader to use multiple threads for loading textures (This means no freeze during loading).

notes.title: Community Card Pack 4 - Art Contest Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/1732a7fe96f60c4f356dbd1606cdc870b41e90a5.png[/img]
Our 2 Million Download festivities continue with the Community Card Pack 4 Art Contest!

We've chosen 6 new card concepts that fit together into a community card pack, and then consulted Orange Juice about fitting concepts for them. Now we're happy to announce the launch of the [b]Community Card Pack 4 Art Contest![/b]

The art contest will be live until July 12, 2023

Like before, art can be submitted for any number of cards and any number of times.

[b]IMPORTANT CHANGE[/b]: Submissions must both be posted in the Artwork section of the steam hub with the tag [b]#100OJcommunitypack[/b] and the name of the Card they are meant for, AND e-mailed to [url=support@fruitbatfactory.com]support@fruitbatfactory.com[/url].

The email must include the following:
[list][*]Subject: 100% Orange Juice Community Card Pack Contest
[*]Name of the card the entry is meant for. 
[*]Link to Steam Artwork section entry.
[*]Desired name to be credited in-game and on social media in case of a win.
[*]Full quality art, plus 2 in-progress versions of the art (or alternatively, a .PSD with several layers to similar effect).[/list]

This change is both due to the unreliability of the Artwork section in displaying all the entries, and to allow us to confirm no entry is AI generated.

The winning entries will be used on the cards, and we will work with Orange Juice to provide flavor texts to match the artwork. Finally, the new Community Card Pack will be released as a free update for everyone to play with!

In addition, the winner of each category will receive the Contest Winner and Contributor in-game pins. Please note the theme listed on each card. This should be used as a general direction for the art. Full rules for the contest can be found at the end of the post.

[h2]List of Cards[/h2]
Warp Control (BOOST)
Next time you step on a warp panel, you are allowed to decide which warp panel to teleport to. 
Theme: Cook reading the wind.

My Wild Friends (BOOST)
(Max 1). Summon a friendly Wild Unit unit onto the board and heal it to full. The summon will automatically engage enemies and can gain stars on winning, giving half of the stars gained to the summoner.
Theme: Teotoratta playing with wild animals.

Contest of Cuteness (BATTLE)
(Max 1). The battle is decided by whoever has the highest cuteness. The winner steals stars equal to 5x the loser's level. Cuteness = 11 - (HP + ATK-EVD) 
Theme: Sham and Saki striking their cute poses in competition with each other.

Rebellion (EVENT)
For 3 chapters, every other player will receive +1 ATK, +1 DEF and +1 EVD when fighting the player currently in first place. 
Theme: Free theme related to Flying Red Barrel.

Bank of Poppo (TRAP)
First person to land on this card loses Lvl x 10 stars. The second person to land on this card gains the lost stars. 
Theme: Featuring a cash card with a Poppo logo on it.

Nanako's Bit (GIFT)
(Max 1). Randomly receive +1 ATK, DEF or EVD the start of battle while this card is held, and lose 7 stars. This card is discarded upon KO or use. 
Theme: Another character using Nanako's Bit for something.

[i]Detailed card descriptions are subject to change.[/i]

[h2]Contest Rules[/h2]
[list][*]Create a new piece of artwork ("Entry") that you feel fits the game 100% Orange Juice and the theme of the chosen new Card (see the list above).
[*]Submission period: Until July 12 2023, 23:59 PST.
[*]Entries must be added to the Artworks section of 100% Orange Juice community hub, with the tag #100OJcommunitypack and name of the Card, and mailed to support@fruitbatfactory.com with the subject "100% Orange Juice Community Card Pack Contest" according to detailed instructions above.
[*]Artwork should be square in shape, or made with the consideration that a square area from it will be used in the Card.
[*]Entry minimum size is 512x512 pixels.
[*]Entries must be original and not contain any copyrighted material and must adhere to Steam Community guidelines. They may not contain purposeful references outside the Orange Juice games.
[*]AI generated submissions are not accepted in any category. Such entries will be disqualified, and if
a winning entry was found to be created using AI afterwards, the placement will be revoked.
[*]Multiple Entries are permitted, as well as Entries for several Cards. 
[*]Text is permitted on the artwork, in the same fashion as it is currently used in some cards.
[*]A minimum of one artwork will be chosen for each Card to be used in the game when the Community Card Pack is added.
[*]Fruitbat Factory reserves the right to not use any of the Entries for a given Card, if they deem none of the submissions are appropriate for it.
[*]Winners will be credited in the Game Info section of the game launcher, as well as on the Card itself, as with existing cards (only after such an update where the Community Card Pack is added to the game).[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer[/h2]
By submitting an Entry, the Entrant grants Fruitbat Factory, Ltd a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free worldwide license under all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to use, publish, distribute, copy, modify, translate, create derivative works based upon, make available and otherwise exploit such Entry. Fruitbat Factory, Ltd may do so in any media formats and channels, in any number of copies, without further notice to Entrant, and without the requirement of permission from or payment to Entrant. In addition, Entrant agrees that Fruitbat Factory, Ltd. may use any ideas from any Entry, whether or not Entrant has been awarded a prize in connection with any such Entry.

We hope to see many cool artworks again! Remember that with the addition of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/workshop/]Steam WorkShop[/url] support, it will be easier than ever for all entries to be added to the game, whether they win or not, and we encourage creators to list their works there once the cards have been added!

notes.title: Unconventional Art Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/083608fe1515eba44c6a39a71ffa762507280628.gif[/img]
As part of the 2 Million Download festivities, we're happy to announce a new kind of community fan art contest that's open to everyone!

This time we're not looking for drawn art, but... anything else! Handicraft, music, live performances, animation, sculptures - if you think it's art, it passes! 

The arts will all be judged in 3 separate categories:

[list][*]Outside of the Box (thinking)
[*]Best Integration of Oranges
[*]Inspirational[/list]

[i]Entries won't need to be submitted to any particular category, and it will be up to the judges to pick which ones are the best fit for each.[/i]

Since this contest is meant for any art that would [b]not[/b] fit our traditional fan art contests, we are not accepting digital illustrations or illustrations drawn on paper this time.

We hope to see some fun entries with this new contest format!

The art contest is now open until [b]May 31, 23:59 PST[/b].

[h1]Prizes![/h1]
10 entries will win in each category!
[list][*][b]1st place[/b]: Plushie of your choice + in-game contest winner pin!
[*][b]2nd-3rd place[/b]: Plushie of your choice!
[*][b]4th-10th place[/b]: Fruitbat Factory game or DLC of choice (some restrictions apply)[/list]

Art can be submitted any number of times.

[i]Important disclaimer: AI generated submissions are not accepted in any category. Such entries will be disqualified, and if a winning entry was found to be created using AI afterwards, the placement will be revoked.[/i]

[h1]Contest Rules[/h1]
[list][*]Create a new piece of artwork (“Entry”) that you feel fits the game 100% Orange Juice.
[*]Submission period: Until May 31 2023 23:59 PST.
[*]Entries or a link to them must be emailed to [url=support@fruitbatfactory.com]support@fruitbatfactory.com[/url] with the header "[b]100% Orange Juice 2M Art Contest Submission[/b]"!
[*]Entries must be original and not contain any copyrighted material and must be suitable to view for audiences of all ages. 
[*]Multiple Entries are permitted, but only one Entry from a single contestant may be selected as a winning piece in any category.
[*]Fruitbat Factory will pick the winners at their discretion.
[*]Less than 10 entries may win in a category if there aren't sufficient high quality entries.
[*]AI generated submissions are not accepted in any category. Such entries will be disqualified, and if a winning entry was found to be created using AI afterwards, the placement will be revoked.
[*]Since this contest is meant for any art that would not fit our traditional fan art contests, digital illustrations or illustrations drawn on paper are not accepted.
[/list]

[h1]Disclaimer[/h1]
By submitting an Entry, the Entrant grants Fruitbat Factory, Ltd a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free worldwide license under all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to use, publish, distribute, copy, modify, translate, create derivative works based upon, make available and otherwise exploit such Entry. Fruitbat Factory, Ltd may do so in any media formats and channels, in any number of copies, without further notice to Entrant, and without the requirement of permission from or payment to Entrant. In addition, Entrant agrees that Fruitbat Factory, Ltd. may use any ideas from any Entry, whether or not Entrant has been awarded a prize in connection with any such Entry.
