notes.title: Getting Festive for 2 Million Downloads!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/189dc985a57ba83636a601ead852ba3156f0fdba.png[/img]
Welcome to the festivities! We're happy to announce a big celebration for 100% Orange Juice hitting 2 million game + DLC downloads thanks to all of your support!

During the 1 million download celebration we added a free new unit, Mio, to the game, and... you guessed it! 

A new unit, Mio (Festive) is now available to all owners of Mio! To unlock her, you need to have played 5 games as Mio, and then clear the new Extra Mission, "Secret Santa", on normal or higher difficulty, while playing as Mio.

[h1]Mio (Festive)![/h1]
[previewyoutube=MjMbkUGMUzY;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MjMbkUGMUzY[/previewyoutube]

[url=https://twitter.com/shiori_izawa]Izawa Shiori[/url] (Nanachi in "Made in Abyss", Pochita in "Chainsaw Man", Kafuru in "Senran Kagura") reprises her role as the wonderful voice for [b]Mio (Festive)[/b]!

Her hyper is illustrated by [url=https://twitter.com/senca_cava]Senca[/url], and special card by [b]Yulay Devlet[/b]!

Please enjoy getting rowdy with her!

[h1]Voices Have Been Liberated![/h1]
As the second major announcement, [b]all character voices are now available for free to all players![/b]

You no longer need to own the DLC to enjoy the characters' banter, even if you only own the base game and nothing more! This is something we've wanted to do for a long time to make the experience better for everyone, and after a lot of thought it's finally been implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/9f8d646ac520617a84990ad71a16d938d9581a50.png[/img]

All base game's character announcers are also available for everyone, to give you a wide selection of great announcers! DLC characters' announcer voices are only available for owners of the DLC (apart from free character rotation).

As a result, we are retiring the following 3 DLC from the Steam store:
[list][*]Starter Character Voice Pack
[*]Core Voice Pack 1
[*]Core Voice Pack 2[/list]

While you can no longer buy these 3 DLC soon (currently pending Steam removal), they continue giving direct unlock of the characters whose voices they contain, which otherwise can be unlocked by playing normally. In addition, to compensate everyone who's bought these DLC over the years, each of the DLC gives their owner a consumable item (so up to 3 total for owners of all DLC), which can be exchanged for either 500 oranges or 10.000 stars each in the in-game Shop!

[i][b]Please note that there's a limit of 999 Oranges and 99.999 Stars that can held at once, so as to not waste your tokens![/b][/i]

In addition, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11016/100_Orange_Juice__Game_of_the_Year_Every_Year_Edition/]Game of the Year Every Year Edition[/url] has been updated to contain [b]Pudding Pack, Breaker Pack and Wanderer Pack[/b] instead of the 3 voice packs, keeping its nominal value the same.

[h1]More Default Color Options![/h1]
To further improve the experience for all new players, we've added new default plate color options! 

In addition, the base character color packs have been removed from the store, and are instead now available by default on all characters!

[h1]Contests![/h1]
To celebrate this momentous occasion, we're announcing 2 separate contests!

[h2]1 - Unconventional Art Contest![/h2]

Introducing a different kind of art contest! This time we're not looking for drawn art, but... anything else! Handicraft, music, live performances, sculptures - if you think it's art, it passes! 

The arts will all be judged in 3 separate categories:

[list][*]Outside of the Box (thinking)
[*]Best Integration of Oranges
[*]Inspirational[/list]

The winner of each category receives the Contest Winner in-game pin. The 1st to 3rd place winners in each category receive a plushie of their choice, and 4th to 10th place will receive a Fruitbat Factory game or DLC of their choice!

The competition is live immediately, and until the end of May! You can find full details on the separate contest announcement.

Submissions can be e-mailed to [b]support@fruitbatfactory.com[/b] with the header "[b]100% Orange Juice 2M Art Contest Submission[/b]"!

[h2]2 - Community Card Pack Art Contest![/h2]

We will be gathering submissions for a new Community Card Pack! This contest will go live in [b]June, after the first art competition has ended.[/b] Competitors will be given the names and effects of upcoming cards, and are invited to come up with art that would fit them. Then cards are given flavor texts based on the winning art, and added to the game.

[i]We can't thank you enough for your continued support! This is only the beginning of the festivities for the upcoming year, as we also have some big anniversaries coming up, and we plan to run more fun contests for them![/i]

notes.title: [April Fools] Massive Changes in Version 4.1.23!
notes.content:
100% Orange Juice version 4.1.23 ~ Poppo's Chaos ~ is now live, and we're excited to share with you the massive changes it has in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/004142390f506ec4834098c22df864d8c1fa8269.png[/img]

[h1]Out with Chaos Mode, In with Poppo Mode![/h1]
Chaos Mode has now been permanently retired. Players who 100% completed it previously will receive the exclusive Piyo (Big) pin. In its place, please enjoy the brand new Poppo Mode! Choose from 50 different "Marie mutators" such as Poppo Tag, Dimensional Poppo, Poppoker, Poppo's Toolbox, and Poppo Painters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/2b8f683725ecdcc3a59052c4405a6f8a841f3a6a.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Character Voices[/h2]
We're thrilled to announce that due to expiring licenses, all character voice packs are being retired. Character DLC will soon be updated to remove their voice components as well.

[h2]Exciting AI Developments[/h2]
After a long effort of discreetly collecting player behavior to train it, we were able to develop our own AI model, called K.AI. Unfortunately, after adding it to the game and tasking it to write a new card to add to the game, it instead played -32768 Final Battles, ate the pudding, rode Big the Jonathan out of bounds and declared itself the owner of the game world. We had to do some scrubbing, but we're fairly certain there are no traces of it left in the game.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list][*]Added new Default Dance and Default Song for all characters.
[*]Added crits! Players now have a random chance to double their attack rolls. The new "crit chance" stat has been added for all units, and many existing cards have been updated to include buffs/debuffs to crit chance.
[*]Added the much-requested optional Light Mode.
[*]Added a new "Sweets type" indicator, which can be found on the back of every Sweets type card.
[*]Added new OJDex entries and pins for Piyo, Mikky Mousse, Dark Santa, and Puyo Puyo Mascot.
[*]Added secondary color customization for Poppo's Bell, Mio's Flames, and Sweet Maker's Lollipops.
[*]Wanted now gives triple wins in Bounty Hunt Mode.
[*]Reworked Chicken's Hyper as the Golden Egg has finally hatched.
[*]All maps are now available in all modes, so you can finally enjoy playing Poppo's Abyss with your friends!
[*]The campaigns of the three starter characters, Suguri, QP and Marc, are now all immediately playable, rather than having to clear one campaign first.
[*]Added the new "ahoge removal" cosmetics for Suguri, Suguri (Ver. 2), Suguri (46 Billion Years), and Saki.
[*]Added the Spectator Chicken cosmetic customization.
[*]Added the Left Handed Mode, which replaces the default game cursor with a left hand.
[*]Removed the Popponese translation, as it was deemed to no longer be distinct from the English language.[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug allowing the player to roll multiple dice at once in Co-op Mode.
[*]Fixed Bad Pudding not counting as a Sweets type card for some characters with different tastes.
[*]Removed Sweet Creator from the game due to an inconsistency.
[*]Store Manager now correctly takes discard damage from Bad Pudding, Flamethrower, and other similar effects.[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list][*]Lowered Iru's base DEF to -1 (from 0)

[i]Dev note: after evaluating Iru's performance, we decided to try something new to make her a bit more in line with where we want her to be.[/i]

[*]Shifu Robo now has 0 REC (down from - REC) due to his poor performance in Bomber Jam.

[i]Dev note: this one's just kind of self-explanatory.[/i]

[*]Lowered Sumika's ATK to 0 to make it accurate to the plushie.

[i]Dev note: well, she did turn out pretty soft, so this just seems appropriate.[/i]

[*]Added a new passive for Marie Poppo: On Norma, draw a Hyper card.

[i]Dev note: we were alerted to a distressing claim of a game Marie Poppo didn't win, so we felt we had to take some drastic action.[/i][/list]

[b]Thank you for another year of support! We hope you'll enjoy these great changes![/b]

notes.title: It's Hunting Time! Bounty Hunt Beta Live!
notes.content:
The long-awaited beta for the updated Bounty Hunt is here! Read below on instructions on how to opt in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/2222c6f403b101f23d5079778451632aa75032c0.png[/img]

This time we are running the beta in two 2-week phases. The first one is now live! After the first beta period, we will collect feedback to implement potential phases for a 2nd phase before the eventual release into live version.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
Starting with some of the core questing changes! Location shuffle now takes place every 7 chapters. In addition, a new Forecast button lets you preview where the field locations will move upon next shuffle. Further, after losing a bounty fight, players can rechallenge the bounty upon recovery, instead of moving. 
Passing a quest location while having duplicates of the same quest contract will now grant only one item instead of as many copies as the duplicate contracts you had.

New perks! Upon each Norma level up, players can choose one of 3 perks to permanently improve their stats or grant other bonuses.

[i]These changes are intended to give players a clearer path of progression toward being able to take down harder bounties at higher levels, while making simple quest gathering a less efficient way to play the entire game.[/i]

A new PvP bounty system has been added! Defeating another player gives the players the Assassin's Badge item, which allows picking up Player Bounties from home panels. These bounties are hidden from other players. In addition, a public bounty is issued for such scoundrels, with a bounty that goes up for every KO they inflict, and which can be claimed by anyone who defeats them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/3f08910513d91310cdc7058b2a0d23ddde38b6ea.png[/img]

A new invader has been added: Lost Rogue! This dangerous new foe may be easier to defeat on paper, but the attempt carries great risk! Players may choose a specific invader, or leave it to be random from lobby options.

New items, and lots and lots of item rebalancing! Combat sweets now last for X battles, instead of X chapters, and are placed in the player's inventory upon purchase. They can be activated from there at will. Shop prices are now adjusted for some characters individually, rather than simply based on their stats.

A new special shop has been added: Shady Merchant. This elusive merchant may appear and offer you their powerful wares at high cost.

Summon characters now have speech bubbles!

...and more!

[h2]How to Join[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/8996df995c1e15eba2e55fe627278327bbc061ed.png[/img]

To participate, go to the properties of 100% Orange Juice in your Steam Library, then BETAS page -> select "beta - Public Beta" from the dropdown menu.

[b]Progress in the beta version is separate from your main save and will not interfere with that when you return to the normal game build.[/b]

Refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/5/3780247517067115373/]this post on the Steam forums[/url] for a list of the current changes! You can also report any issues or give feedback on the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/5/]BH Beta Feedback forum[/url], or through the #100-oj-beta channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/fruitbatfactory]Discord server[/url].

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Fan Art Contest Winners Announced!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for participating the 100% Orange Juice 2022 Fan Art Contest! It was amazing to see so many great entries, and even rewarding 10 winners in each category still left many awesome pieces outside it.

We highly recommend checking all the artwork entries under the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/images/?searchText=%23100ojcontest2022]#100ojcontest2022[/url] tag in the artwork hub!

After seeing the quality of entries, we decided to further expand the rewards: [b]Top 3 entries in each category will all be added into in-game backgrounds![/b]

After a hard judging process, the panel's scores have been tallied. One important note about winners: you might be wondering why a particular great artwork didn't win in any category. Every artist can only win once, so if they made multiple entries, only the one which ranked highest in a category would end up on the winner list even if multiple pieces would've otherwise ranked in top 10! Same piece may also have ranked in several categories, in which case it won in the category where its rank was higher.

Without further ado...

notes.title: Announcing New Fan Art Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/9ac0deedd8e241311d00c931c64b57858660b9f5.png[/img]
We're very happy to announce another community fan art contest that's open to everyone!

Submit a new fan art of your own making to the 100% Orange Juice Steam community Artwork gallery with the hashtag [b]#100ojcontest2022[/b] to enter!

This time all contest entries will be judged under 3 separate categories:
[list][*]Essence of 100% Orange Juice
[*]Coolest
[*]Most wholesome[/list]
[i]Entries won't need to be submitted to any particular category, and it will be up to the judges to pick which ones are the best fit for each.[/i]

We hope to see some fun entries with this new contest format!

The art contest is now open until [b]December 4, 10:00 PST[/b].

[h1]Prizes![/h1]
10 entries will win in each category!
[list][*][b]1st place[/b]: Plushie of your choice + winning art featured in an in-game background + in-game contest winner pin!
[*][b]2nd-3rd place[/b]: Fruitbat Factory game or DLC of choice (some restrictions apply)
[*][b]4th-10th place[/b]: 100% orange Juice DLC of your choice, or a gift copy of 100% Orange Juice.[/list]
Art can be submitted any number of times. Submissions must include the tag [b]#100ojcontest2022[/b] and must be related to 100% Orange Juice in some way. The winner will receive an Orange Juice character plush of their choice (out of available options)!

[h1]Contest Rules[/h1]
[list][*]Create a new piece of artwork (“Entry”) that you feel fits the game 100% Orange Juice.
[*]Submission period: Until December 4 2022, 10:00 PST.
[*]Entries must be added to the Artworks section of 100% Orange Juice community hub, with the tag [b]#100ojcontest2022[/b] and name of the illustration.
[*]Entries must be original and not contain any copyrighted material and must adhere to Steam Community guidelines. They may not contain purposeful references outside the Orange Juice games.
[*]Multiple Entries are permitted, but only one Entry from a single contestant may be selected as a winning piece in any category.
[*]Text is permitted on the artwork.
[*]Fruitbat Factory will pick the winners at their discretion.
[*]Less than 10 entries may win in a category if there aren't sufficient high quality entries.
[/list]
[h1]Disclaimer[/h1]
By submitting an Entry, the Entrant grants Fruitbat Factory, Ltd a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free worldwide license under all copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to use, publish, distribute, copy, modify, translate, create derivative works based upon, make available and otherwise exploit such Entry. Fruitbat Factory, Ltd may do so in any media formats and channels, in any number of copies, without further notice to Entrant, and without the requirement of permission from or payment to Entrant. In addition, Entrant agrees that Fruitbat Factory, Ltd. may use any ideas from any Entry, whether or not Entrant has been awarded a prize in connection with any such Entry.

We hope to see many fun artworks again!

notes.title: Chase the Pumpkins Again!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/fbae549700ddecf2503af41ddc5c99d1513f064f.png[/img]
The long-awaited Operation Halloween event is back!

Chase the pumpkins and unlock spooky Halloween cosmetics!

Based on feedback from the last time, the moving pumpkins will now move more rarely to not slow down the game too much. In addition, players will receive 2 extra pumpkins for placing 1st, and 1 for placing 2nd in a game.

The event has been updated with new costume rewards as well!

[h2]New OJDex Entries & Pins![/h2]
Other changes in this update include 8 new OJDex entries & pins! Aru, Sora, Peat, Tomomo, Syura, Nanako, Saki and Kyousuke now have entries to collect.

Happy Halloween, everyone!

notes.title: Pomeranius and Watty Make a Splash!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/ba43ef0bf721fc5557f4819335f3b7115e9a0e9b.jpg[/img]
Two new friends introduced in the Path of Secrets event, mermaid [b]Watty [/b]and talking dog [b]Pomeranius[/b], are now available to play for owners of the Watty & Pomeranius Character Pack!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2144450/100_Orange_Juice__Watty__Pomeranius_Character_Pack/

You can get the DLC at -10% launch discount, while 100% Orange Juice is also -75% off as part of the Tokyo Game Show sale!

[h1]Watty[/h1]
The cute mermaid with self-confidence issues, Watty may look like an easy target, but don't let that fool you - the more she is bullied, the more dangerous she gets, until an overload of magical power may knock down all opponents! Watty is voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/ono_yuko_ouo]Oono Yuuko[/url] (Nemesis in Infinite Dendrogram, Yuzu in Konohana Kitan)!

[previewyoutube=T4vDtiIk59w;full][/previewyoutube]

-3/+1/+0, 5 HP, REC: 5
After battle, gain 1 stack of Hardened Scales for each point of damage reduced by using Defend (max 5). (For 3 Chapters: gain +1 ATK per stack. Effect expires on KO).

Hyper (Boost): Torrent of Magic
Lvl 2, Cost: 10
Effect Duration: 3 Chapters. Gain +2 DEF. The maximum stacks of Hardened Scales are increased to 10. If you gain 10 stacks of Hardened Scales, all other players suffer KO.

[h1]Pomeranius[/h1]
This emotional support dog has a nose for sniffing out traps, and really makes you want to pet him with his overwhelming cuteness! Pomeranius is given a charming voice by Ogami Shinnosuke (Bakura in Granblue Fantasy)!

[previewyoutube=IOynsYpStqw;full][/previewyoutube]

+1/-1/+0, 5 HP, REC: 5
Ignore any Trap card landed on when your HP is full or higher.

Hyper (Boost): Goodest Boy
Lvl 2, Cost: 20
Effect duration: 3 Chapters
Immune to instant KO effects. When staying on a panel with another player at the end of either player's turn, gain a copy of a random card in their hand. You can neither challenge nor be challenged; instead, opponents may stop to Pet you. Effect expires on KO.

We hope you'll enjoy these 2 new additions to the game's roster!

[h2]New Nath Voice Lines![/h2]
Additionally, version 3.10.2 adds several new voice lines for everyone's favorite augmented heroine, Nath!

Full list of patch notes can be read on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2659871851779396000/]forums[/url].

notes.title: Versioned Hotfix for September 13
notes.content:
An update that increases the internal version was just posted. Please update the game to continue playing online.

This update addresses the following:
[list][*]Fixed Summer Beast's Dance of the Seagulls trap not overhealing.
[*]Fixed costume button highlight inconsistency when loading a cosmetic preset in the deck builder.
[*]Taunt customization menu now uses the new costume buttons.
[*]AI now considers the cost of playing Backdoor trade in decision making, including cost-altering effects.
[*]Fixed Sumika & Alicianrone using voice lines intended for normal Suguri when against Suguri (46 Billion Years)
[*]Fixed various issues related to Sora (Military)'s Burn Out; no longer will Sor always be considered to have 1 more burnout stack hidden and applied to every KO, nor will visible stacks not apply to out-of-combat KOs.
[*]Adjusted Pet Snacks' description clarifying that Pet Snacks in Co-op's effect can stack.
[*]Adjusted Rocket cannon's description clarifying that the upgrade effect is not tied to playing the card itself.
[*]Adjusted Affluence (Co-op)'s description to more closely match in-game behavior, clarifying lack of attack as well as the choosing of following effects.
[*]Adjusted Saint Eyes description to clarify the condition for the depletion of stacks.
[*]Little War and Final Battle now properly set battles to be a certain amount of turns rather than add to it.
[*]Updated White Christsmasher's description and clarified that the hyper scales off player level.
[*]Grouped the Summer 2018 event role hyper cards with other seasonal event cards in the binder.
[*]Heliseed's passive now caps the amount of turns of battle at 3 rounds.
[*]Fixed issues with panel immunity effect interactions with regards to Safe Journey.
[*]Fixed Chris' summons' unit cards appearing on top of fullscreen events like Fish-a-Fish.
[*]Fixed Self-Destruct not affecting units with Solid Witch active.
[*]Attacker CPUs will no longer use Fury vs 1HP minions.
[*]Fixed Summer Beast's Dance of the Seagulls trap not overhealing.
[*]Adjusted Fernet (Noble)'s Co-Op unit card description.
[*]Translated missing Generic Line 8 for Hime (Moonlight) and flavour text of Twilight-Colored Dream for Malt in Spanish translation.[/list]

notes.title: Version 3.10.1 Adds New Event, New OJDex Entries & More!
notes.content:
Version 3.10.1 has just gone live with a number of changes!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Added new event: Path to Secrets, alongside a new Event Map mechanic.
[*]Added pins and OJDex entries for Yuki, Hime, Fernet, and Marie Poppo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/4828b259c834a9406be02dfe5741e70699ff88a2.png[/img]
[*]Added new emotes.
[*]Amount of games required to unlock each character's OJDex entries has been lowered, now being unlocked at multiples of 5 games with the final entry unlocked at 25 games (previously was multiples of 15 games). Pins remain at 50 games.
[*]Re-ordered characters in the OJDex.
[*]Adjusted Magical Massacre's description to specify "other units" instead of "enemies" (effect remains the same).
[*]Improved -noSmartLoading launch parameter for additional loading changes, possibly fixing long time loads for people playing on the x64 executable.[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed softlock when Haruo uses Swarm while Serene Hush is active. New behaviour: If Serene Hush is in play when Swarm is played, Boss will receive the Dash effect, and all minions the following buff for the next battle: "+2 ATK, and if attacking first, enemy cannot counterattack (once per battle).
[*]Fixed Upshift causing characters other than Lone Rider to play their own hyper voicelines
[*]Fixed repeats in the free weekly character rotation. As a side effect, the current free characters will change after this update. Sorry, Lone Rider!
[*]Fixed typos in Natsumi and Kiriko voicelines (English).
[*]Fixed an issue where Special Stage would not properly change the music if it was used immediately after the end of a previous Special Stage.
[*]Fixed CPUs using Special Stage too often.
[*]Fixed the lobby list orange icon for games currently in deck selection spinning slightly off-center.
[*]Fixed Kai's pin missing his glasses.
[*]Added missing Spanish translation of Twilight-Colored Dream (co-op).[/list]

[h2]Plushies![/h2]
We just celebrated reaching 400 backers in the ongoing [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fruitbatfactory/fruitiest-orange-juice-plushies-wave-3]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for Lulu, Krila, Sumika and Kae plushies by releasing this very important video. Please enjoy!

[previewyoutube=NKddat4LaNY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 3.10 Now Live!
notes.content:
Balance:
[list][*]Shifu Robot changes: Slow Start now lasts 2 chapters, and inflicts -1 MOV instead of -1 ATK.[/list]

Fixes:
[list][*]Revamped CPU targeting logic, fixing all issues regarding invalid targets.
[*]Fixed Master Anglers swimsuits relocking and unlocking at random.
[*]Fixed being able to save and load cosmetic loadouts with the dice menu open.
[*]Fixed daily challenges being able to stretch off the screen on low resolutions.
[*]Fixed game crashing when a Bounty Hunt NPC unit steps on a trap set by the Minelayer event.
[*]Fixed the "Restart to apply changes" button in the config screen being invisible.
[*]Fixed the boss and difficulty settings on the co-op menu appearing as blank on first boot of the game.
[*]Fixed Moss Golem in Bounty Hunt Mode having erratic stats when joining an online lobby mid-game.
[*]Fixed a desync caused by taking over for a CPU that has Raging Madness active.
[*]Fixed Guidance of the Weathercock causing only 2 dice to be rolled on x2 panels.
[*]Fixed Bounty Hunt NPC units being affected by Present Thief, Scary Solicitation, Melting Memories, and Treasure Thief.
[*]Fixed Quick Restoration sometimes not activating properly if you healed mid-battle.
[*]Fixed Headless Chicken not applying +2 ATK when the boss has more than 50% HP.
[*]Fixed Mei's Christmashers having the wrong ranges in Co-op.
[*]Added some bias towards landing on Encounter panels for CPU Teo.
[*]Fixed CPU Teo decking "Oh My Friend".
[*]Adjusted CPU logic for determining when to use Star Collector.
[*]Corrected the description of White Christsmasher (Co-op).
[*]Minor consistency edit in Amplify mixer's description.
[*]Various cosmetic fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Summer Brings the Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/bcd18f0c8679f79d3ecfcd5b24d4d7b2bb827b86.png[/img]
We have lots of great news for you again! Version 3.9.9 comes packed with goodies!

[h1]Summer Games![/h1]
Summer Games event is now live again! Help settle the rampaging Summer Beast down, and earn rewards doing so! 

The event has been updated with new Player Plate rewards. Defeating any other co-op boss will also give progress toward completion, but at half the pace.

[h1]Tiger Kigurumi![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/dc89b284a5c64efb7ab1501b17ca6536b2216fb6.png[/img]
A new set of cute Tiger Kigurumi costumes has been added to the Shop!

[i]"Hmm, is there some theme to these costumes...?"[/i]

Summer Games event games may also award you free Tiger Kigurumi costumes upon finishing!

[h1]OJDex![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/4b3e0e51d4a8737734019955bb325c4dfd1d5e49.png[/img]
An exciting new section has been added to the main menu: OJDex!

This section will have a growing selection of character profiles with expanded information on them. Play games with each character to unlock more information!

Playing 50 online games with a character will also unlock a character themed Pin for your avatar plate!

The OJDex starts with Suguri, QP, Kai and Marc, and more characters will be added over time!

Note that your progress in normal games has been retroactively applied for each character. As of this update, however, online games across all game modes will count for characters' OJDex profiles, even for characters who don't have profiles yet!

[h1]Plate Pins![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/a573c33cc0e43c16bed25fa3da83aca08cd29272.png[/img]
A new player plate customization that many players have been asking for is now live: Pins!

Every player may unlock special character pins by playing 50 online games with a character that has been added to the OJDex!

In addition, three new special pins have been added:
[list][*][b]Contest Winner Pin[/b]: this pin can be given to anyone who won an official 100% Orange Juice contest (art contest, etc). 
[*][b]Orange Factory Pin[/b]: this pin indicates a current member of the Fruitbat Factory team, including QA, translators etc.
[*][b]Contributor Pin[/b]: this pin can be given to people who contribute to the game in any way that gets them credited in-game as well, including commissioned artists, voice actors, and current and past team members.[/list]

The pins are awarded via Steam group membership. 

To receive your Pin in-game, you must contact us via email: support (at) fruitbatfactory (dot) com with the following:
[list][*]Your Steam profile link.
[*]Short explanation and proof if relevant (link to winning contest entry or similar) of what that qualifies you for one or more Pins.[/list]

Then you will be invited to the corresponding Steam group(s) and receive your Pin ingame!

[h2]...And more![/h2]
Read the full patch notes on the forums for the other changes!

We hope everyone will have a nice summer (or winter, depending on your local preference)!

notes.title: Two Regular(?) Humans Enter 100% Orange Juice!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/fa4eb156990c96a44ede8c680ae688e99793ead0.png[/img]
As the prophecy foretold, two new characters have entered everyone's favorite chaotic board game!

[b]Shifu[/b] and [b]Hoshino Reika[/b] from the SUGURI universe are now available for owners of the [b]Shifu & Reika Character Pack[/b]! The character pack also comes with a new kitten pet, [b]Masshiro[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1974460/100_Orange_Juice__Shifu__Reika_Character_Pack/

The DLC is enjoying a -10% launch week discount, and 100% Orange Juice is also currently -75% off in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fruitbatfactory]Fruitbat Factory Publisher Sale[/url]!

[h1]Shifu[/h1]
The architect of the Little War in 'SUGURI', Shifu, is voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/hononos/]Fujiwara Hikaru AKA Hono[/url] himself! Avoid risks and manipulate the battlefield to your advantage!
[previewyoutube=JU3S3uSS-Hs;full][/previewyoutube]
+0/-2/+0, 8 HP, REC 5.
Deal +2 battle damage to robotic wild units. When a robotic wild unit defeats an opposing player, gain 1 Win.

Hyper (Event): Ideal World (art: [url=https://twitter.com/kkrtn10]Kokoroten[/url])
Level: 2, Cost: 20
Place an Invasion trap on each Home panel that has no active trap. Each player will battle a robotic wild unit during their next 2 encounters, and this robotic unit will gain +1 ATK. This effect can stack.

[h1]Hoshino Reika[/h1]
What if the girl known as Star Breaker had a normal life instead? The what-if version of the notorious end boss of 'Sora', Hoshino Reika is voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/hirayama8emi]Hirayama Emi[/url] (Reika Kitakami in THE iDOLM@STER Million Live! and Star Breaker in 100% Orange Juice)! 
[previewyoutube=bLbRs2W0Lrc;full][/previewyoutube]
+2/0/0, 3 HP, REC 5.
Can only choose Stars norma. Gain +1 star from all sources except for chapter bonus or from Star Collector.

Hyper (Boost): Star Collector (art: [url=https://twitter.com/Siumai112]Siumai112[/url])
Level 2, Cost: 0

notes.title: Chaos Reigns in Version 4.1! [APRIL FOOL'S]
notes.content:
We're happy to present another massive update!

Version 4.1 adds an all-new game mode, new characters, and so much more!

[h1]New Bosses Land with a Blast![/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b1gP0npxG88][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/29c47b42b3cb4158361cd11eeec48508b5da333c.png[/img][/url]

Two highly anticipated boss characters are finally in! By popular demand, Star Breaker and NoName from the SUGURI series are now available for owners of the new Boss Breaker Pack!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b1gP0npxG88][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/adcf352bd6c6f2ee3078aba7145783e7b3ea3658.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Chaos Reigns![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/827021facfe0b7da800a749800da8f01a9a0f524.png[/img]
[i]On an auspicious day,
two Poppo met each other.
One asked for Chaos.
The other agreed.[/i]

New event, Fool's Gambit, is now live until the end of April! A massive new game mode, Chaos Mode, is playable during it! Chaos mode adds 15 further new game modes that break all the rules!

[list][*]Hyper Deck: All cards in the deck will be changed to pre-generated Hypers.
[*]Panel Shuffle: All panels besides any Warp, and Home panels will be randomized every chapter.
[*]Ultimate Poppomania: All Hypers drawn will be Ubiquitous.
[*]Fair Bully-Zone
Star normas cannot be selected (unless forced). Adjust all unit base stats to be 0/0/0.
[*]Enemy Draft: Selected units will change owners at the beginning of the match.
[*]Ultimate Joker: All cards will act as they were level 1 and have no cost.
[*]Bring Down The Tank: One player at random will see their HP increased by 50, and their base ATK will be set to be 2, while being impervious to KO card effects. Other players gain a permanent Dash. All cards are free to play and will act as they were level 1. If defeated, the other 3 players win the game. If not defeated under 30 chapters, the Tank wins the game.
[*]Unstable Selection: Chosen characters are changed to a random character.
[*]100% Mixed Juice! All stats are randomized at the beginning of the game. All Hypers drawn will be random.
[*]Multiplication Sensation: All stats, effects, and durations are multiplied by 2.
[*]Faerize: All players will be changed into Aurora. A friendly bot taking over the unit you chose initially will join you on your panel, and share wins and stars. Your friendly bot is the only unit capable to norma. Guide your bot to victory to win the game.
[*]Maxtension: All battle cards are replaced with Extension, which in this modifier becomes Level 1.
[*]Poppoformation: All players turn into Poppo for two chapters after a random interval of 2-10 chapters.
[*]Four Heavenly Kings: Each player will play as a random Co-op boss.
[*]Forced Exchange: Every 5 chapters, at the start of the chapter, all cards in players hands are randomly redistributed as if Gift Exchange has been played.
[*]Bomberjam: Everyone gets to place bombs down on their turn. It will explode in a random duration. You may also dash around a short distance.
[*]Dynamis Dice: Choose the outcome of your dice roll. Once a number is picked, it will remain unavailable until all other numbers are used.
[*]Shopaholic: Bounty Hunt shops will spawn on random panels, with tweaked item selection.
[*]Knights and Faeries: At the beginning of the match, choose either to play as a Guardian, or Aurora, with modified attributes. All Hypers drawn will be random, and unexpected events may occur.[/list]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/a56a26b4c748fc2eb7e36f2715483a43706c0ba8.png[/img]
[list][*]100% Orange Juice has been updated with a new, sleek logo!
[*]Added a target indicator during Raging Madness, so there can be no more imposters among the opponents.
[*]Home Improvement will now give players furniture instead of cards.
[*]Cards such as Dinner, Pet Snacks and BanaNana now satisfy Cook's hunger.
[*]Spectators can now bet stars on who will win the match. Once you've earned 5000 stars this way, your reward is a "Spectator" headwear for Haruo.
[*]Marie Poppo is now added to the Wild Unit pool. This new wild unit has -1/-1/-1, 5 HP, and steals a star for every point of damage she deals. She will also randomly screech if no one has challenged her for a while.
[*]Natsumi's secret title updated to "Sweet TikToker." Corresponding voice lines have also been updated.
[*]Fixed profanity filter not applying to lobby passwords.
[*]Made Santa's Workshop use the final episode of Crossed Xmases theme as a field theme.
[*]Removed Merry Poppo from players upon finishing the Master of the Minions event.
[*]Texts with the correct language translation missing now display in Popponese.
[*]Added a VR mode to the game. 4 strangers enter a VR room together, where they find themselves bound to a home post, and equipped with Mimyuu's Hammer.[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list][*]Malt can now perform a special defensive move called "castling", where Malt moves two spaces towards Flying Castle, and the Flying Castle warps just behind Malt. This move can only be performed if Malt or the Flying Castle has not moved during the game yet.
[*]Dash is now Max 10.
[*]Iru DEF increased to 0, up from -1.
[*]Poppo is now forklift certified.
[*]Mei: White Christsmasher range increased from 0 to 1. Now also discards your hand on use. True White Christsmasher range increased from 1 to 2.
[*]Cuties got a pay cut after crashing too many events.
[*]Suguri (46 Billion Years): Double Damage cost reduced to +50% (down from +100%).
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible for players to have enough stars to play Star-Blasting Light.[/list]

We're also happy to announce a new Kickstarter campaign for plushies for the 100% Orange Juice plushies coming soon! Prototypes for the plushies' plushies are almost finished! A new plushie sprite set is being added to the game for the corresponding plushie pet for owners of each plushie's plushie.

notes.title: Version 3.9. Adds Improved Performance, Balance, Pet Modding and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/788eec0b019377821612157fdf257ed563f18d47.png[/img]
Version 3.9 is now live for 100% Orange Juice!

This time we've focused on technical improvements, as well as various balance updates.

[h1]64-Bit Update[/h1]
100% Orange Juice has been updated to 64-bit architecture, which increases the amount of memory the game can use. This should result in improved performance for users. 32-bit is still supported for the time being, for those who may need it.

[h1]Graphics Update for Performance[/h1]
More archives have been converted to a new .DDS format, which significantly improves graphic handling operations.

NOTE: Old mods using archives that have been updated to .DDS format still work.

[h1]New Launcher[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/5f06f19d23304bd5199d3b05a157b100bbde1c09.png[/img]
The old game launcher has been updated with a new look that's more pleasant to the eye!

[h1]Pet Modding[/h1]
Workshop support for the game has now been updated to include pet graphics! Modders have full control over pet parameters like size and movement speed. The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189405817]Modding Documentation[/url] has been updated with instructions for them!

[h1]Balance Updates[/h1]
[h2]Halena[/h2]
Passive now generates Level x2 stars, down from Level x 3.

[h2]Lone Rider[/h2]
Lone Rider now has 0 base defense (down from +1). Lonely Road now grants +1 DEF as well. Lonely Road now triggers on move rolls higher than 6 (up from 6 or higher). Cost of Upshift has doubled from 5+5x stack to 10+10 x stack.

[i]Dev note: These balance changes are larger than what we usually apply, but that's because Lone Rider was performing significantly better than characters can be usually expected to. The most problematic areas were identified as a combination of setting up a high number of Upshift too easily, which also means an almost non-stop Lonely Road making his stats too good. With these changes triggering Lonely Road requires more setup, but still has the same synergies as before, and there's a more significant cost to getting a high stack of Upshift. Since it's a large change, we'll be monitoring to make sure the effects didn't end up too punishing.[/i]

[h2]Arthur[/h2]
Shops now increase Bonus panel and Shop star gain, not star gain from all sources.

[h2]Tsih[/h2]
Stealth On now prevents triggering Encounter and Boss Encounter panels.

[h2]Alicianrone[/h2]
Alicianrone now procures +1 EVD if facing an enemy with +1 ATK, and +2 EVD if facing an enemy with +2 ATK or more (down from 'higher than +1 or +2 ATK').

[h2]Suguri (46 Billion Years)[/h2]
Observer of Eternity now allows playing another card after using it.

[h2]Iru[/h2]
In a much requested change, Iru no longer goes second when challenging an opponent. DEF has been lowered back to -1 (down from 0).

[h2]Tomomo (Casual)[/h2]
Red Bean Ice Cream is no longer discarded on battle KO.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list][*]Poppo has intensified once more.
[*]Accelerator now has a new Hyper animation visible when playing a Suguri.
[*]Many minor changes and fixes, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2659871851779396000/9]full list on the forums[/url].[/list]

notes.title: Learn to Swim with Tomomo! Big Co-Op Update Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/282d9d74b8af3b8a96c9f2393adabf8ef2cbf807.png[/img]
It's time to learn to swim [strike]or sink[/strike] with Tomomo! Mio's lending you a helping hand in the new Co-op summer event, "Pool Party"! 

The event adds a new co-op boss "Swimming Coach", and progress is shared between all players!
Note that you can also fight other Co-op bosses to contribute to the event progress, but you need to defeat Swimming Coach at least once to qualify for rewards.

The event is active until September 26! Three new achievements related to the boss have also been added.

This time the event ending illustration is courtesy of artist [url=https://twitter.com/49_0]490[/url]!

[h2]Co-op changes![/h2]
With the feedback from the Co-op survey and the Co-op beta, we've also released a whole slate of changes to improve the game mode! You can read the full patch notes on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2659871851779396000/]Steam forums[/url].

[h2]CPU picker![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/abc7c63fd1c36a9f81206f0861c568b0d267ba39.png[/img]
One notable change in the update is a new CPU picker feature! This new feature allows you to choose your CPU teammates in Co-op mode online and offline, and in single player Normal and Bounty Hunt modes as well!

[h2]Unit Info on Hover[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/44e78b8d9129685f2d80a1a8a0df2e562c46f393.png[/img]
Another much requested improvement has also been added: you can now mouseover units on the field to view their HP, and click on them for detailed info. Hovering them also shows the Recovery value for KO'd units, as well as star cost to revive them in Co-op.


[h2]Field Brightness Setting![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/a0fec87667d52b35da4343dc7efa577e507d7e7b.png[/img]

+0/+1/-1, 5 HP, REC 5.

notes.title: Version 3.5 Adds New Cards, Player Plate Customization And Much More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/508c514f46cd873a6a4e2c2f8e83298e254cea5a.png[/img]
Version 3.5 - Home Improvement - is here, with a slew of new features for you! 

[h1]Community Card Pack 3![/h1]
Six new cards are now available in Community Card Pack 3!

[b]Overtime (BOOST)[/b]
Level 3, Cost: 10
(Max 1). For this turn, roll 3 dice for movement. Skip next turn.

[b]Deceptive Disarming (BATTLE)[/b]
Level 3, Cost: 10
(Max 1). If opponent uses a battle card in this battle, if not restricted by player order its effect is applied as though you played it instead. If successful, opponent does not pay the card cost.

[b]Pet Snacks (EVENT)[/b]
Level 1, Cost: 5
Each different wild unit gains +1/+1/+1 during its next battle.

[b]Home Improvement (EVENT)[/b]
Level 1, Cost: 5
(Max 1). At the start of your next turn, randomly swap home panel positions. The first player to land on each home draws a card.

[b]BanaNana (TRAP)[/b]
Level 1, Cost:0
Roll to move again without activating this panel.

[b]Lucky Sevens (GIFT)[/b]
Level 1, Cost: 0
(Max 1). While holding this card, your natural die rolls can range from 0 to 7, and the minimum roll result is 0 when rolling 0. Cannot perform a Norma check after rolling a 0 for move on the same turn.

The cards are available in the Shop for 1080 stars per booster pack (minus store discounts).

[b]6 new achievements[/b] related to the new cards have also been added to the game!

[h1]Player Plate Customization![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/55a3175f45194c2fb74110bc13ca2c4344df0bbf.png[/img]

Another big change in version 3.5 is the new ability to [b]customize your player plate[/b]! You can do this via Avatar Customization under Player Info.

Player plate background and frame can be customized separately. Everyone starts with 4 options for player plate frame and 5 options for the player plate background. 

Additional frames are unlocked retroactively for reaching online level 10, 25, 50, 75 and 100. A number of backgrounds are unlocked retroactively based on all completed events and single player campaigns.

In addition, a special set of 4 player plate backgrounds with art by [b]Usanekorin[/b] from the Level 99 Games LLC [url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange]board game Bullet🍊[/url] are unlocked upon reaching online Level 99!

[h1]Updated Valentine's Event![/h1]
Chocolate for the Sweet Gods event is now active until May 10! The event has been updated with new rewards, as well as all rewards of the 2017 Valentine's event, and a new ending illustration by [b]hexun[/b]!

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Changes:
[list][*]All the Community Card Packs now have a random booster pack art in the Shop, which changes every time you launch the game.
[*]Lowered the price of Community Card Pack 2 boosters to 580 stars.
[*]Added a new button in the lobby to toggle the visibility of each player's avatar.
[*]Made various changes to the text and layout of the player plates.
[*]Changed pet button in character customization to use an icon instead of text.
[*]Increased space for unit names in config voice tab.
[*]RoPoChi's Delusional Numbers now has RoPoChi roll a minmum of 0 in battle as well.
[*]Mousse skin can now be unlocked separate from any events through a hidden mechanism.
[*]Marked 800x600 resolution as 'Legacy' in the launcher.

[i]Dev note: The game's original 800x600 resolution with its limited screen estate has been a consistent issue for implementing new features, but we're aware that some people are still using it. That's why we've decided to allow some visual features to be omitted or display less than optimally on 800x600, in order to both keep the resolution functional for the foreseeable future, and to give us the freedom to improve the game's GUI more freely.[/i]
[/list]

Fixes
[list][*]It is no longer possible to send hearts to Co-op bosses.
[*]Doom now properly awards Soul Eater to the Harbinger.
[*]Fixed Doom removing incorrect stock effects when it takes effect.
[*]Fixed a bug with cards stacking in the Match 2 minigame of Playground.
[*]Arnelle's Intelligence Officer passive now properly shows cards instead of white squares.
[/list]

Balance
[list][*]Wolly DEF is now 3 (up from 2).
[*]Bunnizard HP is now 10 (up from 9).
[*]Turnislime now gives an additional -1 ATK if your ATK is 2 or higher at the start of battle.

[i]Dev note: We discovered that Wolly, Bunnizard and Turnislime have been performing as significantly 'easier' Bounties for their difficulty, and these changes are aimed to make them slightly more troublesome to bring down without changing their overall design, making the mode more balanced regardless of which Bounties are randomized..[/i]

[*]Deploy Bits cost is now 10 (down from 20).

[i]Dev note: while Nanako's Hyper is strong, its random nature made it less reliable than other battle Hypers for its cost. The new cost should be more consistent with its benefits.[/i]

[*]Scrambled Eve cost is now 20 (up from 5). New description: All players return their hand to the deck, and the deck is shuffled. After 3 chapters, all players draw as many cards as they discarded from this effect.

[i]Dev note: Scrambled Eve has been a topic of much debate both internally and externally. It has a very strong card control utility - which remains mostly unchanged with this change, but it also had a long-lasting effect of just making the games more boring by removing "plays" due to leaving people's hands empty. With this change to how Scrambled Eve functions we both give it more tactical use with the potential of hand size related plays, and it (eventually) gives the players newfound power with the extra card draw, keeping the match more exciting. We also didn't feel the star reimbursement was really thematic with the card, and given its card control power we opted to remove that and make it more expensive to use instead.[/i]

[*]Alte now sees a random battle card from the opponent's hand in battle (as opposed to a random card).

[i]Dev note: We've long wanted to improve Alte's utility somewhat, and while testing the new cards I think we've homed in on an idea that has a good synergy for her. The new Searchlight passive will only trigger when the opponent is holding one or more battle cards, so it gives Alte a great ability to play around her opponent's battle card choices.[/i]

[*]Princess' Privilege can now be used when it is the only card in your hand, or when holding 3 or more cards.

[i]While the strongest card draw card, Princess' Privilege hasn't seen much use because of its severe usage limitations. This new utility combines its original function with the more recent one, making it much easier to put to use.[/i]

[*]Heat 300% is now a Stock Effect (1), instead of Effect Duration: 3.

[i]Dev note:Not a major change, but after the change Heat 300% guarantees its severe debuff triggering, making it somewhat more dangerous.[/i]

[*]Serious Battle is now limited to Max 1.

[i]Dev note: Multiple copies of Serious Battle was deemed much power for certain characters to carry.[/i]

[*]Lowered Dark Side of Business cost to 5 (down from 10).

[*]Buffed Krila's name to Krilalaris.
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy the new presents!

We're hyped to announce that 100% Orange Juice - The Movie is coming soon to cinemas near you! This is an extended 6-hour Poppo Cut of the critically acclaimed feature film "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LVB-99_jbC8]Poppo March[/url]" lovingly remastered for IMAX and 4DX and featuring all-new content including a long-awaited appearance by the elusive Shroppo!

[h1]New event: Pigfestation![/h1]
New event combining a Valentine's Event and Pigformation is now live, allowing players to spread the good cheer of Pigformation! All Flying Red Barrels begin the event with the blessing of 'Pigformation' which can only be lifted by KO'ing another unaffected unit. The KO'd unit in turn becomes permanently Pigformed until it KOs another unit to pass on the blessing! In addition, Feed appears randomly on panels and can be collected by walking through them. Feed can be used in the Shop to directly give the blessing of Pigformation to your units that do not yet have it.

[h1]Free Bonus Character![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/8780491b501c30c062ecb9f3c38ab40bc7f2f834.png[/img]
Owners of 100% Orange Juice on any platform now have access to a mysterious bonus character called [b]"Kai"[/b] in 100% Orange Juice! He can be selected as one of the starter characters or purchased in the Shop later.

[h2]New Languages Supported![/h2]
We're happy to announce the addition of official support for 102 new languages to 100% Orange Juice! Going forward, all language options other than Japanese will be provided via Google Translate for the benefit of the highest number of players possible! With the new approach, we're also able to fully dub the game into all 109 supported languages via a revolutionary Text-to-Speech feature! To beta test the new features, click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2422376810]here[/url].

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list][*]You can now pet the dog in 100% Orange Juice, and give her pudding.
[*]Landing on a Boss panel will sometimes no longer result in a fight as all the bosses have taken anger management classes and are handling things in healthier ways now.
[*]Added safety rails for panels to prevent units under the effect of Freeze panels or BanaNana from falling into the endless abyss.
[*]Due to new game rating guidelines, all Flying Red Barrel characters have been changed to bottles of their respective beverages to remain compliant. This change is only visual and does not affect gameplay.
[*]The Waruda have vandalized the lobby avatar frames again, and the city put out a bidding competition for their repairs. Team Poppo won the bid promising to do it for 0 stars, and will be visiting all avatar frames soon to fix them. They've asked players to collect all their valuables in one place so they do not get any paint on them.
[/list]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list][*]Limited Serious Battle to Max 1.
[*]Lowered the cost of Deploy Bits from 20 to 10.
[*]Lowered the cost of Dark Side of Business from 10 to 5.
[*]Buffed Krila's unit name to Krilalaris.
[*]Changed how Scrambled Eve functions. New description: All players return their hand to the deck, and the deck is shuffled. After 3 chapters, all players draw as many cards as they discarded from this effect.
[*]Changed the effect of Princess' Privilege. New effect: If holding more 3 or more cards, discard all cards in your hand and draw 3 cards. If Princess's Privilege is the only card you are holding, draw 3 cards. Can only be used when holding more than 1 and less than 3 cards in your hand.
[*]Changed the effect of Heat 300%. New effect: Stock Effect(1): In the next battle, gain -2 DEF.
[*]Maynie: Fighting a Boss under the effect of Raging Madness now ends the battle and the unit is referred to an anger management class for 3 chapters.
[/list]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where playing as Chef would sometimes display as Chris outside of battles.
[*]Fixed the visual appearance of Alicianrone, who no longer wears shoes on her feet alone but also on her hands and head.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/d8f40d2da073a000075c6184f0f5ff0e9fb75ff4.png[/img]
The Community Card Pack 3 art contest is over!

This time around we had a record number of submissions - 188 in total, over 30 more than for last community pack! Thus it was even harder to pick the winners out of so many great submissions!

We put together a large panel of judges combined from Fruitbat Factory and Orange Juice, and gave everyone a difficult task: choose your Top 10 entries for each card, and rank them in order. 10-20 points were then given to every card based on the every judge's ranking (with a baseline of 10 points to cards not selected for top 10 to avoid a single vote swinging things too much).

A common sentiment was that even selecting top 10 out of the submissions for each card was difficult, but this gave a sense of fairness to the results which were a combination of everyone's opinions.

It was a close race to the finish for most cards, so although only one art could win, we want to showcase the top 3 for each. In addition, we're giving a special shout-out to an "Editor's Pick" for each card category for a card that received several top votes for their unique qualities but didn't end up making it to the top in the total scoring.

notes.title: Version 3.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]100% Orange Juice - version 3.4 now live![/h1]
[h1]Bounty Hunt[/h1]
Bounty Hunt is a permanent new "race" type of game mode where 4 players compete to reach 20 Fame first by doing delivery Quests and fighting various monsters for Bounties. 

The updated version comes with 12 different Bounty monsters, 12 Quest locations, and 4 Shop types! For every match, 2 random easy, medium and hard Bounties, and 6 Quest locations are chosen randomly, so every game will play out differently!

As a new feature, cards can now be sold to the Shops for stars! Each Shop can give different prices for different cards.

Each Shop type can further be upgraded by selling cards and buying items from them, up to level 10. Higher level shops give discounts, increased item stacks, and more rare items! Many new items have been added to spice up the game mode.

New summons are also available: Aurora, who will heal and revive the player, and Guardian, who will independently hunt for Bounty monsters you have a contract for and give you Fame on wins.

Lastly, a mysterious invader called the Harbinger may appear after Chapter 15, and start hunting the players...

Certain cards and units behave differently in the Bounty Hunt mode.

Note that Bounty Hunt is a somewhat longer than the other game modes, and in return EXP, Stars and Orange rewards give a +50% bonus in this mode.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Added Bounty Hunt game mode.
[*]Added Bounty Hungers event.
[*]Added new field, Beginner Town (Winter)
[*]The modding system has been updated and expanded:
[*]Can now mod Panel graphics
[*]Can now mod Homestop graphics
[*]Custom translations can now be distributed via mod system
[*]A better error check has been added. JSON errors will show up in the mod list, pointing out the issue (if any).
[*]You can now modify the volume of custom music with a dedicated parameter.
[*]New HUD added for minions.
[*]6 new achievements related to Bounty Hunt have been added to the game.
[*]Reduced the overall VRAM usage.
[*]Improved the networking code by adding additional catch-ups in case the host would disconnect.
[*]Added a card binder tab for Bounty Hunt.
[*]Added an HUD element displaying the HP status of summons. (will not display for 800x600).
[*]Added a separate win tracker for online Bounty Hunt wins.[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]The game will no longer act as Idle CPU if someone engage a battle with you on the first chapter before your turn.
[*]The damaged pose of Castle (chocolate color) no longer has a grey cannon.
[*]Fixed Peat's Santa Scramble outfit + Christmas color not saving/restore cosmetics properly
[*]Fixed the same with Fernet + swimsuit + Halloween color.
[*]Fixed a graphic issue when using Mio with Christmas color + Rein costume.
[*]Fixed Seagull's glasses not being on the right layer when using the kigurumi costumes.
[*]Fixed the Wanderers Episode 1, Episode 3, and Episode 4 having a wrong background when seen in the gallery.
[*]Fixed the Waruda Christmas Party ending cutscene showing a wrong background transition.
[*]Fixed an issue with Cuties zombie skin + glasses combo.[/list]

notes.title: Community Card Pack 3: Art Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/2c87603c79e382b59100689a12ebfb1e73847e7e.png[/img]
It's time!

After combing through the estimated 2000+ submissions to choose 6 new card concepts that fit together into a pack, and then consulting OrangeJuice about fitting concepts for them, we're happy to now move into the next phase of the Community Card Pack 3 creation: [b]The Art Contest[/b]!

The art contest will be live until March 1, 2021!

Like before, art can be submitted for any number of cards and any number of times. 

IMPORTANT: Submissions must include the tag [b]#100OJcommunitypack[/b] and the name of the Card they are meant for. 

The winning entries will be used on the cards, and we will work with Orange Juice to provide flavor texts to match the artwork. Finally, the new Community Card Pack will be released as a free update for everyone to play with!

Please note the theme listed on each card. This should be used as a general direction for the art. Full rules for the contest can be found at the end of the post.

[h1]List of Cards[/h1]
Overtime (BOOST)
(Max 1). Roll 3 dice for movement. Skip next turn.
Theme: Free concept related to working overtime.

Deceptive Disarming (BATTLE)
(Max 1).  If opponent uses a battle card in this battle, if not restricted by player order its effect is applied as though you played it instead.
Theme: Merchant's train is being inspected by the authorities. 

Pet Snacks (EVENT)
(Max 1). All wild units gain +1/+1/+1 during their next battle.
Theme: A young looking character playing with animals.

Home Improvement (EVENT)
(Max 1.) Randomly swap home panel positions. 
Theme: Sumika remodeling Shifu's spaceship.

BanaNana (TRAP)
Roll to move again without activating this panel.
Theme: Someone tripping or about to trip on Nanako in Banana costume.

Lucky Sevens (GIFT)
(Max 1).  While holding this card, your natural die rolls can range from 0 to 7. Discard on KO or use.
Theme: Yuki with an 8-sided die.

[i]Detailed card descriptions are subject to change.[/i]

[h1]Contest Rules[/h1]
[list][*]Create a new piece of artwork (“Entry”) that you feel fits the game 100% Orange Juice and the theme of the chosen new Card (see the list above).
[*]Submission period: February 1 to March 1, 2021, 23:59 PST.
[*]Entries must be added to the Artworks section of 100% Orange Juice community hub, with the tag #100OJcommunitypack and name of the Card.
[*]Artwork should be square in shape, or made with the consideration that a square area from it will be used in the Card.
[*]Entry minimum size is 512x512 pixels.
[*]Entries must be original and not contain any copyrighted material and must adhere to Steam Community guidelines. They may not contain purposeful references outside the Orange Juice games.
[*]Multiple Entries are permitted, as well as Entries for several Cards.
[*]Text is permitted on the artwork, in the same fashion as it is currently used in some cards.
[*]A minimum of one artwork will be chosen for each Card to be used in the game when the Community Card Pack is added.
[*]Fruitbat Factory reserves the right to not use any of the Entries for a given Card, if they deem none of the submissions are appropriate for it.
[*]Winners will be credited in the Game Info section of the game launcher, as well as on the Card itself, as with existing cards (only after such an update where the Community Card Pack is added to the game).[/list]

[h1]Disclaimer[/h1]

notes.title: Workshop and More Added in Version 3.0!
notes.content:
It's a big day for 100% Orange Juice - version 3.0 is officially here! 

Here is a short summary of the new features, before we go into more detail:
[h1]Version 3.0 New Features[/h1]
[list][*]Steam Workshop Support
[*]Mod Support Extended to Card Art, BGM, Voices & SFX
[*]A new Arcade floor in the Shop with game machines
[*]A new global event, Shroom Zoom, alongside a new field
[*]3 New Field Events and a new panel type
[*]Beach Party has been added to Retired Events[/list]

[h2]Steam Workshop Support![/h2]
Let's start with the big one! 100% Orange Juice now has Steam Workshop support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/ab6facfb3fdbd50af7f66bed2fe8f7c92fc2b0f6.png[/img]

Moreover, mod support has been extended to:
[list][*]Card Art!
[*]BGM tracks!
[*]Character voices!
[*]Sound effects![/list]

A [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2189405817]detailed Workshop guide here[/url] explains how the new Workshop mods work, and how you can make and share them!

Sharing and using mods is now super easy! Just nagivate the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/workshop/]Workshop[/url] and subscribe to any mods you wish to use! They will be downloaded and installed to your game automatically, and updated if new versions of them are made. You can even rate the mods in-game after trying them out!

[h2]A New Arcade Floor[/h2]
A new floor has opened in the Arcade building of the shopping street! Take the escalator to reach a new gaming floor that currently hosts 3 brand-new arcade machines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/91862849284689f2d678aca6707d15a908f1453e.png[/img]

For 100 stars, you can choose to play [b]Fish-a-Fish, Playground, and Build-a-Castle events[/b] with various options! Practice the minigames, or just play for fun!

[h2]A new event, Shroom Zoom![/h2]
A new global event, Shroom Zoom, has been added to the game! You can see a separate announcement for more details.

The event continues the adventures of Ellie and Lulu, and adds a new field, Fungus Cave, which can be permanently unlocked from completing the event. Work together with other players to find the legendary mushrooms!

[h2]New Field Events and Panel Type![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/aa60507fb6ba6b872b2503833df593749766e679.png[/img]
A new type of panel is now in the game: [b]Goo panel[/b]! Moving into panels with Goo takes an additional point of movement.

Moreover, 3 new Field Events have been added to the game!
[list][*]Fish-a-Fish: The fishing event from Master Anglers event is now available as a field event, which activates every 9 chapters.
[*]Spores: Spawns mushrooms on the field, which give free cards with random effects when picked up.
[*]Goo: The opposite of Freeze event, this event adds Goo to panels every 5 chapters - the affected panels still activate, but moving into them takes an extra point of movement per panel![/list]

[h2]Beach Party Added to Retired Events![/h2]
Finally, the first summer event from 2018, Beach Party, has been added to Retired Events in the Shop!

To activate the event, begin by purchasing the Beach Party module from the Retired Events shop. After watching the event starting scene, defeat Big the Jonathan 10 times to complete the event. Once the ending cutscene has been viewed, all the rewards of the Beach Party event can be purchased from the Retired Events shop.

[i]There are even more changes in version 3.0, for full list check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2659871851779396000/]patch note thread[/url]![/i]

We hope you'll enjoy this version 3.0! The fun never stops in 100% Orange Juice!

notes.title: Announcing Community Card Pack 3 Card Contest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/1db2ead5c159e1285b62a9c5ea6e8a2c8411573b.png[/img]
Have a card you [i]really[/i] want to see in 100% Orange Juice and can't believe it doesn't already exist? Now it's time to get those creative juices flowing! 

Introducing a card contest for Community Card Pack 3! 

The contest will have 2 phases:
[h2]Phase 1: Concepts[/h2]
[b]Active: September 7 to October 5 PST.[/b]

Unlike last time, when we used the surplus from the first Community Card Pack for the card ideas phase, the game has evolved quite a bit so we want to give everyone a fresh chance to pitch cool new ideas.

Last time we received about 2000 card concept submissions. Can we do better this time? Make us find out the hard way!

The card pack will contain a minimum of 1 Boost, Battle, Event, Trap and Gift card. Just head on over to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2949250308641844523/]this thread[/url] and submit your ideas.

The Community Card Pack will be produced as follows:

1. Suggestions may be submitted in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/282800/discussions/0/2949250308641844523/]this thread[/url] until the end of October 5 (PST). Suggestions can include card type, name, effect and cost/level, but general suggestions and discussion on other suggestions are welcome too. Flavor texts are not necessary. Suggestions don't need to be unique, so don't worry about reading every single other idea in the thread. You may also include several ideas in the same post if you wish.

2. Fruitbat Factory will select an appropriate mix of concepts from the thread and modify them as we see fit. Fruitbat Factory may add other cards to the mix as well, if some niche turns out to not be met.

3. Fruitbat Factory and Orange Juice will prepare concepts for the final card selection.

4. An art contest will be launched to create community art for the new cards.

5. Fruitbat Factory and Orange Juice will prepare flavor texts based on the art for the final card selection.

6. The new cards will be added as a free new card pack into the game.

[strike]7. The community is, as always, solely responsible for any bugs the new cards introduce.[/strike]

By submitting a suggestion in the designated thread, you agree to waive any demand to credit or compensation regarding any text and concepts you propose with the full understanding that that the only reward you receive is the happiness from helping add new content to the game (Suggestions may overlap and it may be impossible to accurately credit or reward them afterwards). Fruitbat Factory reserves the right to modify the suggestions and to not use any of them at their discretion.

[h2]Phase 2: Art Contest[/h2]
After we have finished processing the submissions and selected winning card entries, and discussed their concept with Orange Juice, we will run a new [b]Art Contest[/b] for them! More detail will be released on this when it's time.

Take it easy on us!

notes.title: Modding Support and Turn Timer Options Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/0b7a9e0d6b579855bf7be079768bc87ac66673d4.png[/img]
Version 2.9.5 adds big new features again!

[h1]Modding Support[/h1]
For the industrious players who have already been making graphic mods for 100% Orange Juice, and those who would liked to if it weren't so difficult, we have great news! 

It is now possible to create graphic mods in order to override existing unit textures in the game. Mods are managed in a separate folder and won't be affected by the game updates or other modifications. See the [url=
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GC63DntRWPV00zKe1y9r48mvMbcjHVWEuuNaKSMBbtQ/]online documentation here[/url] for more information about how to get started! 

This is the first step toward possible Workshop support, and we'll be looking for feedback on the implementation, as well as seeing if it presents any issues.

[h1]Turn Timers![/h1]

notes.title: Enter a New World with a Bounty Hunt!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/4033ce7d5edfc2bf05830eea4b605977368f3910.png[/img]
The first event of the 100% Orange Juice Season 2 storyline is now live in version 2.9 ~Lucky Charm~!

The "Bounty Hunters" event introduces a new pair of characters, Ellie and Lulu, who have to make ends meet by taking on the dangerous job of hunting monsters for cash!

The story for the event is written by Hono of Orange Juice, and the ending illustration is provided by [url=https://twitter.com/ogipote]Ogipote[/url]!

A new Bounty Hunt game mode is temporarily playable for the duration of the event, until [b]May 17, 10 AM PST[/b].

To complete the event, players must climb from rank E to rank B in their Guild.

[h1]Bounty Hunt[/h1]
In Bounty Hunt mode, players will increase their Guild rank by gathering Fame from completing various quests at the local Guild. These include hunting down dangerous new monsters, and performing odd jobs around town.

There are 6 new Wild Units and 1 new Boss unique to the mode.

In this event, several rules differ from the normal mode:
[list][*]There is only 1 Norma type available: Fame. Fame is gained from defeating Bounties and completing Quests. Reach 20 Fame to win the game! (Note that norma selection restrictions of certain characters don't apply in this mode).
[*]All units have a permanent +1 MOV, +1 hand size, and gain increased stars each chapter.
[*]Different types of field locations appear on random panels, and are refreshed every 6 chapters. These include monster locations, and Shops.
[*]Players can stop at all Homes, and every time you stop at a Home, you can choose 1 out of 4 available Bounty or Quest cards. These cards must be carried to complete missions.
[*]Bounties are completed by carrying the corresponding Bounty card and defeating the monster in question. Each field location houses one of the 6 monster types, and once a player passes over it, the monster is revealed. If the player is carrying a Bounty card for that monster, they can challenge it to battle. Each player starts the game with one easy difficulty Bounty card.
[*][b]Each Bounty battle lasts up to 10 rounds, and the monsters come in 3 different difficulties, giving 2,3 or 4 Fame.[/b]
[*]Quests require to visit a field location of the indicated type to gather a quest item, and then returning it to the indicated Shop. They give 2 Fame for completing.
[*]Different Shops carry various powerful items - cards, healing, temporary buffs and even permanent stat boosts!
[*]Shop prices are affected by your character's stats: Based on the default stat spread of +0/+0/+0, 5 HP, characters will gain an adjustment to their Shop prices based on how positive or negative each of their stats is. (ATK gives a 25% modifier, while DEF, EVD and HP give 10%. Example: Marie Poppo gains a -25% discount based on -1 ATK, -1 DEF, -1 EVD and +2 HP, while Sherry gains a +45% price increase based on +1 ATK, DEF and EVD).
[*]Defeating the field Boss will give 6 Fame to the one landing the killing blow.[/list]

A funky new field, Beginner Town, is available to play during the event, and can be permanently unlocked as a reward.

[h2]Other version 2.9 ~Lucky Charm~ changes[/h2]
[list][*]AI got jealous of players and are now able to randomly have unit and hair colors, and wear glasses.
[*]Co-op lobbies now have a tooltip on the player frame, showing their co-op levels.
[*]Fixed a crash with how card effects gets removed on a player revive.[/list]

[*]Changed the DAMAGE message to no longer cap the number at player HP. The damage dealt is still the same, but you'll be able to tell that Big Bang Bell really really hurt.

[*]Made minigames stop the public lobby idle timer.

Fixes:
[list][*]Fixed graphical issues with Alte's school uniform when using her Halloween 2016 tennis player accessory.
[*]Fixed a 4-legged Marc.
[*]Fixed black unit color unlock not showing up properly on Results screen.
[*]Fixed issue with chat typing window staying open between lobby changes.
[*]Fixed issue with shop exit button not being highlighted when hovered.
[*]Fixed Bloodlust's damage being affected by some damage reduction effects.

[i]While a minor change, this affects some head to head match-ups significantly. Originally NoName was vulnerable to all such effects (x16 Big Rocket, Air Strike, etc), but in version 1.19 he was changed to turn into pot form instead of KO when KO'd out of combat also, in order to make him more possible to actually KO for real. This had the side effect of giving him unnecessary extra immunity to some card/unit effects, and we're now rectifying that.[/i]

notes.title: Crash the School + Big Chat Update!
notes.content:

The little Waruda miscreant [b]Mimyuu[/b], always ready to cause mischief, is voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/kitakatanatuki]Kita Natsuki[/url]!

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list][*]Suguri (and Suguri ver.2) have been updated with several new voice lines.
[*]Added a speech bubble display for characters in Deck Builder and customization menus.
[*]Changed Starship's boss to be Shifu Robot.
[*]Fixed characters not playing their warp voice when landing on warp move panels.
[*]Fixed a graphical bug that would make Tomato's portrait not focus on her face.[/list]

[h1]Xmas Wreaths Extended[/h1]
We hear the complaints from players who expected to be able to still earn Xmas wreaths after the earlier Xmas event re-run! Xmas Wreaths now drop from all games until end of the year (Steam time)! Xmas costumes for new characters have also been added to the Shop!

notes.title: The Master Cometh
notes.content:
It's the moment you've been awaiting... "Mama" has come home!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/be88a2e92bafaa13b0bb62f2f061d2ecbf7552b4.png[/img]

Concluding the 100% Orange Juice 5th year Steam anniversary storyline, [b]Master of the Minions[/b] event is now live!. The event brings about [b]massive[/b] changes!

[h1]Master of the Minions[/h1]
[list][*]The unique event will be live until January 14, 10 AM PST. It features an epic conclusion to the "Minions of the Master" story arc written by Hono of Orange Juice, and an ending illustration by Kagawa Yusaku.
[*]A new co-op boss has been added, alongside 5 new co-op fields: Frost Cave CO, Icy Hideout CO, Starship CO, White Winter CO, Tomomo's Abyss CO.
[*]A global counter will unlock rewards during the event. You can contribute toward event progress by fighting the new co-op boss - but fighting any of the other co-op bosses will also support the struggle at half the progress rate.[/list]

[h1]Co-op changes[/h1]
Tomomo's giving everyone a helping hand against the overwhelming foe! Co-op leveling has been drastically eased:
[list][*]All ability bonuses and base abilities are available for each role at level 1.
[*]Level 5 unlocks role hyper for each role.
[*]Level 10 unlocks the role special ability (there's no longer a lvl 2 version of the role special abilities available to unlock, though the stronger ability can still be used via the role hyper).
[*]Lowered cooldowns for Level 10 ultimate role abilities, and some effects slightly modified.
[*]All Deck Points are earned by Level 10.
[*]Level cap has been removed from role levels, so players may earn Orange rewards beyond level 25.
[*]You can now play on any available co-op field on Normal difficulty.[/list]

[h1]Mixers![/h1]
A further mix-up has affected all co-op bosses! There's now an optional "Mixers" option for co-op lobbies! Mixers add a special new twist to all co-op encounters, making them harder, easier, or just trickier than before. Difficult Mixers increase your rewards on every difficulty. Mixers change daily and are the same for all players. There may be 1-3 Mixers active each day, and you can preview them when creating a lobby, or on the lobby screen.

notes.title: Jonathan Is Back!
notes.content:

Hello dear beach-goers! We're happy to inform you that a wonderful beach vacation opportunity is open once more! Take a vacation on Treasure Island in a re-run of the "Beach Party" event - safety from gulls not guaranteed.

The original Beach Party event is now available to play until September 4, with all the previous rewards. Moreover, Big the Jonathan has been updated to a complete co-op mode encounter and will be permanently available to challenge.

The event will also unlock a new field, "Over the Sea," to use in regular matches. Note: to unlock the rewards including the new field, you will need to play at least 1 match against Big the Jonathan during the event.

Along the event, version 2.3 also adds an all-new Summer Pet Catcher containing summer themed pets, and a new Vending Machine that allows purchasing the in-game consumables with oranges!

[h1]Full version 2.3 patch notes[/h1]
General:
[list][*]Arcade has been updated with a new look.
[*]Summer Pet Machine added to the Arcade with summer-themed pets.
[*]Vending machine can now be found in the Arcade, allows purchasing consumable items for 20 oranges.
[*]A total of 15 new pets added to the Pet Catcher and Summer Pet Catcher. Common and Uncommon items pools are shared between the machines.
[*]A one-time bonus of 15 Arcade Tokens is given to all players upon logging in for checking out the new pet catcher.
[*]Pet Exchange has been upgraded with a cool new animation.
[*]Added new challenges for playing specific card types + dealing/healing damage.
[*]A new panel type, Damage Panel, has been added to the game (deals 1 damage to players who stop on it).
[*]Fixed CPUs considering the original panel type instead of the current panel type when choosing where to move.
[*]Adjusted some CPU panel preferences.
[*]Made CPUs favor landing on boss panels if the boss is on low HP.
[*]Fixed Slime pet lacking some visual flair it was supposed to have.
[*]Fixed Special Stage effect preview not being removed on KO.[/list]

Co-op
[list][*]Big the Jonathan is now back in the Beach Party event rerun (with a reduced global goal), and will remain as a permanent co-op boss.
[*]Fixed Nico being able to use Banned for Life in co-op with it activating its effects.
[*]Fixed being able to target players with Stealth On! or Special Stage stocked with boost cards in Co-op.
[*]Dealer role can now be unlocked by reaching level 10 as Supporter.[/list]
